Small little place on 12th main, came here for a few desserts, has the red velvel pastry, Choco almond and chocolate mud jar.

Loved the chocolate mud the best, the Choco almond was a little dry and not that fresh.

But overall a good place!

Do visit!

Been here once. I have always seen this cute patisserie in Indiranagar, however I stopped by only yesterday.

Ambience and decor is minimalist and elegant,loved it!
Their desserts looked really good. I ordered the hazelnut delight ( I think thats what it was called) and the bacon quiche.

I took it home, the packing was really cute and sturdy.

The dessert was nice, tasted like a Nutella mousse with some cake inside,nothing to complain. But the quiche was definitely at least a day old. The shell was soggy and the filling was dry, which was a bummer because the flavour was alright.

If you have a sweet tooth, this is definitely a place you can consider. Brownie points for the sweet guy at the counter who knew what the components of everything was?

Happy munching ?

We ordered a sizzling brownie at this place. And I absolutely loved it. A small tiny place with around 3 tables .the service was really great

Food : ????????

Was searching for a nice coffee shop in indiranagar when we found this place.
Loved the ambience. Service here is exceptional.
One of best place for coffee / tea in indiranagar.
Highly recommended ..
Nice, nice and nice. So after a long schlep around the area the sight of a Chinese restaurant is so welcome. The ambience is pleasing, the food tasty and it's pretty reasonable too.

We had ordered 2 noodle, chicken Manchurian combo but one of the combo pack had no chicken... And when reached the customer care.. they did nothing about it..
The food was overall good... The 2stars are for not giving what was ordered
Very Tasty food. Just loved the way they prepared it. it was authentic Chinese. momos fried rice just perfect. dragon chicken was delicious.

Good food that scores high on quantity and taste. Try their combos, which are worth the money. Had ordered the chicken combo and it came perfectly packaged. So, they managed to fit in (but in good way) two varieties of chicken including tasty drums of heaven in semi-gravy form, two hot momos, and sauce. Read most of the reviews of this place and I agree with them. It is value for money although I would not recommend having often from this place as (with most places serving Chinese fare) they tend to go a little overboard with the unhealthy ingredients.
As for me, would like to visit this place sometime soon.

Taste: 3.5/5
Value for money: 4/5
Delivery: 3/5
Packaging: 4/5

Felt like eating Chinese today and found this new restaurant in BTM while searching on Zomato.
Though I doubted to order ,it did not upset me .
We ordered the Veg Noodles combo and Peking Paneer.
I must say that this was a great deal at decent price. The quantity of food is more than enough for one person. Momos in the combo were huge and tasty. Baby corn was slight saltier than normal for me so could not eat all. Peking Veg was mouth watering .Paneer (in Peking paneer ) was fresh and soft . I would recommend this place for sure and try these things if you are looking for noodles/momo/Manchurian all in one :).
The packaging was nice , it was provided with chilly sauce and red sauce.
Overall a pleasant experience .

Nitesh C

One among those places that could be categorized as more quality and less quantity. Not satisfied with the price and the quantity that was provided. However the dishes were pretty good. Ordered pothu fry & vazattiyathu and would recommend the same
Amazing place for authentic Kerala food. Loved their kappa udachathu and pothu vazhattyathu. Absolutely lipsmacking and must tries. Malabar chicken biryani was also really good.

Its been long since I wrote something about restaurant. For past 2 days, I am using this restaurant for take away. Quality of the food is worth every penny. Quantity is also up to the mark. You can feel the real taste of Kerala. They took time to give the food but it was worth the wait.
The all time classical. Great music..great food and a perfect ambience. The gallery side seatings are the main attraction here to watch the citylights.

?
Good place for brewery. Not much crowded, good food, good music, good food and good service. Overall a good experience.
Both malnad chilli chicken and Chicken ghee roast were good.

Located right in the middle of the city it's very easy to access this restaurant.This pub is a very nice place to hang out with friends. It has lot of tables & ample spaces to sit. Best part is happy hour drinks. Ensure to place your order before 6 to get the Happy hour benefits. It has a very good view on top.Fabulous rooftop microbrewery with stunning 360 degree views and a pool and regularly changing specialist beers. The staff are extremely polite and accommodate people really well.

A nice place for drinks and food. Opted for beer, rum and a mocktail. We ordered Masala peanuts and a Donne biryani. We repeated the drinks and spent close to an hour or two on a Saturday night!
The place was very lively and happening! We had a good time and throughout, the service was courteous.

Been here for a sunday brunch. Opted for poolside and it was such a waste. First they din let us sit beside the pool and then the poolside was closed since 5 people were there! Coming to the food, its as bad as it gets. Hardly 2 or 3 items tasted good. Rest all were bad and not worth the hype and the price. If not for their beers, nobody would go to this place for a brunch. Totally disappointed!
Top floor with great view of bengaluru and huge place as well. Pool is in there on rooftop for romantic dinner or may be party I really don?t know. Go get some food and drinks on top
Great place. Had loads of fun dancing the night away. Great crowd, good music, ambience is typical and pizzas are great. Highly recommended. Advance booking is recommended
Great place for brunch as well as dinner. Fun ambience, polite and prompt staff. Pizzas are great and to top it off happy hours make the place a steal for the quality of food, drinks and service.

Its actually a 3.5 stars. The place is on the 10th floor,a rooftop with an okayish view of the city.When I went,it had decent music and really good finger food and beer. The service is slow but not bad that one should be complaining. There is an area which is completely hep and the music is loud and the other area is a bit secluded on the same floor where one could sit and talk peacefully along with enjoying the music and the night. I chose the latter and was really happy.

Beautiful bar with live music and screens. Also with the microbrewery and having polite staff this is one of the beautiful place Started with some of their house beers like Richmond Ale and Club special brew beer with some food Mushroom Risotto, Carnivore Platter and Peri Peri Chicken Pizzas. The food was amazing and so with the service.

Enjoyed a lot here.

A horrible way to spend time and money. Not sure what is 4* worthy in this place. They made us pay upfront even before offering us a place to sit. Beautiful bar with live music and screens. A horrible way to spend time and money. Not sure what is 4* worthy in this place. They made us pay upfront even before offering us a place to sit. When most of the restaurants are giving good food at competitive price, i paid way more than rs.200 for a dish with tiny chichen pieces (small pieces of wings, mostly bones). Gravy was below average, generic with no particular taste. Hugely disappointed.

Have been ordering a wide variety of cakes from her. Almost, all of the cakes in my office were baked by her. Love her cheese cakes. Best part is that she can customizes the cakes for you. The only draw back is that we need to pick up the cake from her place but it is totally worth it! Would be placing my next order soon..
Absolutely love her deserts- since many years we've been ordering her deserts and each one of them are delicious, fresh and fantastic! This is a must try for a special occassion

Ordered crunchie almond praline cake for wife's birthday. It was probably the best birthday cake we had. Everyone in the party was raving about the cake and folks on diet too succumbed to guilty pleasure and ate their fill :) I had ordered this just a day before the birthday and she was kind enough to make it ready in less than a day.

The almonds were really nice and crunchie. I could make from the taste that quality of ingredients used were of very good quality.

No home delivery so have to pick it up yourself.

Sure of ordering more cakes from Shilpa.

A good dessert is a simple thing that can make a meal or occasion really special. When that is what you need, think of Shilpa Gulati.... Her desserts are  delicious, creative, fresh, pretty to look at, delivered when promised... and did I mention delicious, because they really are! Highly recommend her cakes, munchies and chocolates. This is a sureshot hit every time!

I tried Shilpa Gulati's cake for the first time today, it was amazing! By far the best dessert I've had in a long time!
I had ordered a chocolate fudge and salted caramel ice cream cake, and would recommend it to all!
Thank you for such a wonderful cake Shilpa Gulati :)
Simply yumilious! The best desserts and chocolates you can get in town. Cheese cakes, brownies, munchies, layered cakes, almond flake chocolates... Have tried them all and I keep going back for more.
Everything here is Yummmm! Perfectly crafted to perfection desserts with the right amount of everything! Have orders here for baby announcements, birthday parties and dinners..

I've always liked Shilpas desserts . Today we had a Mango Cheese cake . Very nice .. Great value for money and prepared with love. Keep it up.
Ideal orders for home parties and as a gift to friends .

Cakes here are simply fantastic!

If you want to read a book, study or something like that, this is the place to be. You can order and sit here for hours together and do your work. It's very peaceful and comfortable.
The quantity is more than enough, but the price does not quantify the quality. The rice was undercooked, so flavourless. Need to improve the taste and quality for sure

Very good Arabian style restaurant and very awesome food and it's verities are approachable.
We usually go here for official lunch, also with a very good ambiance. Do visit here
Great ambiance and some great food but not the Arabian cuisine though. Rest, the food, service and ambiance is really good! Would recommend this place for some good food in and around J P Nagar

Can this really be called an Arabian restaurant? No. The menu is mostly filled with typical Indian/Mughlai and Chinese dishes, and the Arabian share is limited to some barbecues. Honestly I was pretty disappointed with their barbecues. It was undercooked and missed the fire character. Though the marination was good, it tasted raw. Surprised that they served Rumali Roti as the side for barbecue instead of Kubboos or any Arabic bread, and the roti was hard and rubbery, inedible. Restaurants like Zaitoon and Fattoush serve absolutely delicious barbecues, even Empire would be a better choice. On the other hand, prawns were delicious and soft like silk.

Ambience is great. Neatly and tastefully done interiors. Pretty good for large groups and families. Service is very good too.

If you have a craving for Middle Eastern delicacies, now your taste buds would find a justification at Least Arabia. Superb interiors and courteous attendants. The foods are great, specially, the Arabian Shawarma, Nawab Chicken and Irani Kebab are a must try.

We strolled into this place on a mid weekday night . The one we visited was close to brigade road. It s a small space, not so packed for a weekday. We ordered the wings which are a favourite here. Pretty much everyone were ordering that ! Besides that we had the pizza which was quite good .
Waiters were not trained properly and had diff in placing order!!

Food 2.5/5
Service 3/5
Ambience 3/5
Pricing 3.5/5

Looking for some place to chill with your friends or go on an date... Then this might be the place for you. Food quantity and quality is good. Food-4/5
Staff-4/5
Ambience-4/5

Plan B has been synonymous with providing the best Chicken Wings in Bangalore. However, when I visited this place, it seemed quite overhyped.
The place had dim lights and wooden tables. The ambience was very dull.
Coming to the service, it was very bad. The waiters were a bit ignorant. Water was leaking from my glass and after telling them several times, they changed it.

We had ordered Spicy Garlic Chicken Wings and Creamy Buffalo Chicken Wings. Spicy Garlic Chicken Wings tasted alright while Creamy Buffalo Chicken Wings was quite good.
Moreover, Zomato Gold is a must if you're visiting this place. The dishes would be quite affordable then.
In a nutshell, what I felt is that this place needs to step up its game and live upto people's expectations as people hope for a lot from them.

Food-4/5
Service-1.5/5
Ambience-3.5/5

OVERALL-3/5
I went there in 8th Feb with my cousins it was good experience for me.cloudy place Ambenice is good and cocktail is awesome,and the nonveg platter is so yummy.

Nice place for quick bites and beer.

Burgers are good here and pretty good options for vegetarians as well.

Ambience is nice and creative with many things recycled into a cozy place and dim lights which makes a perfect place for drink with your friends.

Loaded Nachos is a must try. Chilly potatoes, Peri peri fries also were good and good cocktails and mocktails as well.

Food: 4.5/5
Ambience:. 4/5

Visited this place recently on a Saturday evening around 5 pm. It was my second visit. Visited mainly to try out their peri peri wings as it tasted good the first time i visited. Here's my opinion of this place :

Food : We ordered the naked peri peri wings and the juicy Lucy ( beef ) burger. As far as i can remember the same wings tasted better when i last visited about a year ago. This time it was good but not great and there was nothing special about the burger ( it was eatable - not bad but not good either )

Ambience : Ambience is mediocre and is dimly lit compared to many other places

Service : Even though we didn't face any problem with the customer service i noticed that one of the waiters was clueless about our query

Seating : Seating is on cushionless wooden chairs and is uncomfortable

Music : I had no problem with the music that was being played

We ordered motherclucker chicken burger, bacon burger and a few others. All the burgers were tasty and cheesy accept the chicken one. Its a good place to go if you're craving burgers and good beer. They also serve good wings and have zomato gold.
Busy friendly and good burgers. We were shopping in mg road and decided to try out this place. It surpassed our expectations from a small and unfacied place

I am a huge fan of planB wings!!!!
So we went to this place on a Saturday noon and it was empty but nevertheless we went and ordered the mighty spicy garlic wings and it was yummyyyyy I loved it.
We also had their paneer shashlik and it was pretty bad!!
Their Service is the worst I've ever experienced!!!

Plan B has got lot's of different offer on each particular day of a week. The ambience of the place is quite appreciatble. It's quite good for the price and thr best part of the place is even the drinks are priced at a very reasonable price along with the food ;)

'A** Burning Spice (ABS) challenge..!!' That's how I know this place. This meat love joint is known for its spicy bar food. One of my favorite hang out places in terms of a calm and shady bar.
The food here never disappoints. The spices never cease to make one cry. Their appetizers are the best and they also have some good beers. The food might take some time to get served at the table. But the wait is just worth it.

Must try: Fiery Chicken, Geist

Might wanna try: ABS Wings, All appetizers

Should never try: None

Food: 4.5
Drinks: 4
Pricing: High
Service: 3
Ambience: 3.5

visited Plan B in order to save my burger hunger, Ordered Juicy Lucy and Chicken special burger, it was floppy, saucy and fresh, will be super if they can add cheese toppings over it.
One of the best fast food center!!!

This place is at a walkable distance from the MG ROAD METRO STATION. This place was definitely a must visit for all burger lovers.
Coming to drinks, the only alcoholic drinks this place serve is the beer and some beer cocktails.
I heard the Bulls Eye beer cocktail was good but I stuck to my regular,Diet Coke.
The naked Peri Peri Wings were just too good and was spicy enough to justify its name.
The chicken cheese meatballs were kind of good.
The bacon wrapped chicken sausages were ok.
The Black Sheep Burger was big but the party was kind of small but with all the toppings it was a big burger.
The prices are high but ya one can definitely try this type of food.

Dropped in with friends and tried the following:

Chicken Wings (Honey Chilli Sauce)
Beef Chilli Cheese Fries
Jalapeno Peppers
Sauteed Mushrooms

The Beef Chilli Cheese Fries was good tastewise but somehow disappointed me in terms of the quantity of fries, given the nature of the dish. I suggest if you are a fries person go for the Cheesy Garlic Fries.

The Jalapeno Peppers was passable and I recommend you give this a skip. The Sauteed Mushrooms which one of my friends really wanted to try, was a disappointment too.

The Chicken Wings is a must-try dish (goes best with the honey chilli sauce). Don't miss it.

P.S - Zomato Gold users get 1+1 on food.

visited Plan B in order to save my burger hunger, Ordered Juicy Lucy and Chicken special burger, it was floppy, saucy and fresh, will be super if they can add cheese toppings over it.
One of the best fast food center!!!

This place is at a walkable distance from the MG ROAD METRO STATION. This place was definitely a must visit for all burger lovers.
Coming to drinks, the only alcoholic drinks this place serve is the beer and some beer cocktails.
I heard the Bulls Eye beer cocktail was good but I stuck to my regular,Diet Coke.
The naked Peri Peri Wings were just too good and was spicy enough to justify its name.
The chicken cheese meatballs were kind of good.
The bacon wrapped chicken sausages were ok.
The Black Sheep Burger was big but the party was kind of small but with all the toppings it was a big burger.
The prices are high but ya one can definitely try this type of food.

Dropped in with friends and tried the following:

Chicken Wings (Honey Chilli Sauce)
Beef Chilli Cheese Fries
Jalapeno Peppers
Sauteed Mushrooms

The Beef Chilli Cheese Fries was good tastewise but somehow disappointed me in terms of the quantity of fries, given the nature of the dish. I suggest if you are a fries person go for the Cheesy Garlic Fries.

The Jalapeno Peppers was passable and I recommend you give this a skip. The Sauteed Mushrooms which one of my friends really wanted to try, was a disappointment too.

The Chicken Wings is a must-try dish (goes best with the honey chilli sauce). Don't miss it.

P.S - Zomato Gold users get 1+1 on food.

When i hear chicken wings the first place that pops up is plan b, they have some seriously good wings some of my favorites are the peri peri wings and the honey chilly wings. Their burgers are also known to be amazing but the wings are a must have when you go here.

All the other items were lip smacking too. Should visit this place often. Pricing is a bit too expensive. Quantity is fine and a must visit with friends.
A nice cozy place for some great beer and good food. We had the Peri Peri chicken which has the perfect spices which goes perfectly with drinks. It's a must have. The service is fast and friendly.

Whenever we are in brigade road, Plan B is the place we end up. Coming to the most recent visit, we tried the Tex mex chicken nachos, 2-3 varieties of beer, burgers and stuff. The food is appropriate and for some reason they have taken down their famous ABS challenge as I think many people have cracked it already. Anyways and Always VFM is the key factor which lands me there but certainly there needs to be some major improvements in Food as it was not worth the hype like it used to be. Ambience and service makes my rating to 4 than 3.

Terrible would be an understatement to describe my recent visit here. We ordered a watermelon juice and a mocktail, both which were heavy in sugar. I insisted the juice be replaced, so it was.

Coming to the food, we ordered the BBQ platter. The ribs were inedible and pathetic. I called the manager and told him and he tried to justify saying it was "slow cooked". As though we haven't tried slow cooked meat. It was rubbery and impossible to swallow. What's worse is he never offered a replacement. I used to like coming here, few years ago. Now going by the food, drinks and service, I'm definitely not going back.
This will always be one of my fav bar/res in Bangalore :) Spend my whole college life here. This place has the best chicken wings and coorg pork curry :)

Everything's overpriced for a restaurant that looks so bad. The waiter and the manager were arrogant. Had a very bad time dealing to get my order done. Finally I had to leave after waiting for 20mins without the order. Worst ever experience at any restaurant till date.

No body gives a damn about when you're walking out without an order. They don't mind losing a business.

Don't expect them to speak English or Kannada. All that they know is to speak in Hindi. One bad experience.
Good place with limited crowd if you want to drink peaceful this is the best place and mushroom biryani is very nice but they have limited dishes
Pretty decent spread of buffet from starters to main course and desserts. Reasonably priced also. Not sure why such a low rating of 2.4 only.

Worst place! I went ther to get a starter, i ordered chicken lollipop. A plate of chicken lollipop costed me 320 Rs after taxes n when i opened it had 5 thin pieces! Really 320 for that. No wonder it was empty when i reached there. At this rate Hopefully it will close down soon.

The ambiance of Paprica (Infusion) Bangalore is chirpy and is good for at chit chat with your group of friends. The food served at Paprica (Infusion) Bangalore is mainly North Indian, Chinese continental and fusion food and so it indicates that the food is lip smashingly spicy and finger lickingly delicious.

I don't know why this place deserves a low rating. It's an average restaurant but serves good food. We have booked the banquet Hall once and also gave our first anniversary party there. All the guests appreciated the food. The only issue out here is parking. If you aren't lucky you will have a tough time to find a place to park.

diaryofmoments.com

I had been here f,or the dinner buffet on a Sunday. The cost of buffet as Rs.450 + taxes, but after tasting the food I found it is not worth the money at all!! The starters were kind of okay but rest all terrible! The mutton maincourse had nothing in it but bones, fish tasted very bad! All I could enoy was the vanilla ice cream and green salad!
The unfortunate part is that we ordered two mocktails, which was the worst mocktails I ever had! I could taste only some syrup and too sweet!
I will never recommed the restaurant to anyone.
I had been the bar here, which was not too bad, went to restaurant with same expectation but total disappointment.

We went out for a team outing and group of around 15+ people. The dishes served on that day was good and hear it was customised on that particular day as per request. Everything was good apart from the crowd and looks like a dry day with very few people occupying the tables on a weekday.

Excellent food, really appreciated. Ambience for drinks and hookah is excellent. Really enjoyed. At least I will visit here for good food. And staff is also so cooperative. Really good environment to enjoy some peaceful time in reasonable cost.

It's a decent place for sure . It is located just a couple of blocks from Kalamandir in Marathahlli .The food is good enough and you can not complain about the food in any sense.If you stay in Marathahlli or areas close by , it should be good option for you.
Talking about the ambiance , it needs to be worked upon but the bar area in the corner is comfy.
The worst part is the service which works at a snail's pace and brings the whole mojo of this place  down .The staff is not swift and it might get a little hard pressed to wait longer for your order to arrive sometimes if you have a large group.

Discovered an awesome place. Great food ambience. Visited once then kept coming back. Love their sheesha lounge for hookah. Great service and very reasonable too. Their potato cheese balls, chilli paneer is awesome . main course is also yum

In marathalli i have visited almost all restaurant the best was paprika
FOOD 5/5 Awesome all food was tasty
TIME 5/5 Very fast
Ambience 4/5

Totally No 1 place around marathalli

Starting from food... We had ordered a lot of things. . The chicken starters( we tasted almost every chicken starter) were good. The chilly prawn was too much spicy, more of chilly. Manchow soup was ok, it had an Indian touch(too much spicy).
Main course was good... kashmiri pulao was the best thing that we had.
Price was also decent. So all in all, a good one-time-eat restaurant.

The food has no complain absolutely .the ambience too is good . The small glass setup lounge is a great addition . You can try for any dish and m sure u wont be dissappinted.but yes price may bite u . They need to work on it as the cuisines arent that special . Only concern is the service here . Too lame ,late and lazy .
One of the worst lounge bars I have seen. Food is okay. They play TV serials in lounge bar. No good music. Not a good place for young crowd. I would rate it 2

Awesome hookah. I have been to this place only for just hookah. I saw this place in zomato and called them asked whether they serve hookah. They told that they serve hookah, me and my friend rushed to that place. It was a restaurant at starting and has a small lounge which serves hookah and drinks. I ordered for pan raas and kiwi, hookah maker(mithun) he promised me that he will make a best hookah. It was late but he made the best hookah and he was very dedicated at serving. I don't known about food and all but the hookah was really good.

Humble request, DO NOT ATTEMPT to go to this restaurant .

This is highly unprofessional " road side" Dhaba one must not dare to visit.

I was here last year and again after an year I happened to visit this place. The first thing I liked about this place is the hookah. We hardly asked the guy to refill the coal. The worst part was that we ordered cheese balls and he gave us 6 on the plate without any sauce. And when we asked for it, the response came in was very rude, saying they don't serve tomato sauce or any sauce with this item. That was weird. You normally get sauce to eat with it. The music was good till 11 pm and then they started playing some old sad songs which was again beyond our understanding why would someone play sad songs after 11. Just because its the closing time? I would prefer to visit this place again, if it is for hookah but not for the food for sure.

We took lunch buffet. It was fine. Not one if the best buffet which you might be expecting. The non veg section had traditional starters and then main course. The dishes were decent and not that amazing. Nothing new about the buffet. The disappointment was at the peak, when it came to desert.. The oly thing which made me give this rating was servicing and the behaviour of the people working there. Ambience is pretty cool. There is a separate place for bar and drinks.

Before visiting this place, I read reviews here and as per reviews written here, it was true, very few people were there even on a Friday night.They have a lounge and dining area. They have Buffet for around 400rs (lunch).We went for dinner, ordered Thai chicken as a starter which was not as expected, but soup and chicken tikka in the main course were palatable.Naan was very stringy, and we told this to the lady who was taking the order, in response she offered a complimentary drink.Service was very slow, they took a lot of time to bring the main course.The finger bowl had cold water.

We went to this place on a weekend and to my surprise it was all empty!
so my friends and me decided to sit in the lounge.
We ordered some babycorn and chicken starters. Both tasted very nice. for main course we had ordered some fried rice and some chicken side dish. That tasted good too. And the drinks served was also very nicely made.
The price was not much and the service was good too. 
I am still surprised why this place was empty that night. :) Would recommend to give this place a try atleast once. :)

Ambience is good, has a small bar and a lounge.
Had buffet both the times.It was not that satisfactory in terms of food.
Liked chicken and corn starters.

They server good mocktails and drinks.
Loved the karaoke room most in this place. If you have a big group do book that room before.

I went to Paprica(Infusion) with my team and shocked to see that whole restaurant was empty except 4-5 people. I asked the manager at the counter whether they serve buffet or not and the lady kindly said yes. They did not served the starters on the Table. we have to do self service for the starters also. There were not starters in the bowls as all the bowls were empty. we got the starters after 30 mins. 1) Quality of food was good.2) Staff was kind.3) Ambience was awesome.4) Nice Place for the Drinkers.Best thing in this whole experience were the mocktails that were ordered by me and my team mates. Been twice and both the times on Fridays for a lunch buffet. Did not have the great taste but there are wide varieties of dishes and the lounge came to my rescue. The place looked shady. I'm not coming back any time soon.

We went there on a weekday and had the Rs. 449 buffet spread and I would say it was OK. The ambience was good and the seating arrangements were also quite nice. Coming to the food, I would like to highlight the following points:
1. There were no drinks or mocktails on offer
2. Starters were good; there were chicken 65, mixed veg manchurian with good amount of sweet corn, chicken kabab etc
3. In the main course they had noodles and chicken biriyani which was ok. Naan rotis were good but the mutton gosht was quite ordinary
4. Desserts were very limited and only vanilla falvoured ice cream was on offer along with moong dal halwa which was good. We requested for gulab jamuns but it was turned down. So really disappointed with the variety
So, I would definitely not go there for a second time and it was not value for money for me.

Came here for a Friday lunch. Took the regular non-veg buffet. Must say not a very wide range of dishes laid out. We sat inside the lounge which is towards one end of the restaurant. It was quite cozy with sofas and bean bags.

Starters - Chicken manchurian, mix veg manchurian, coleslaw salad, cream of chicken soup, masala papad, hara bhara kababs, some grams salad. As I said not very assorted.

Mocktails - we ordered virgin caloda and mango crush.

Main Course - only plain nans were there, yellow dal tadka, plain rice, mutton rogan gosh, chicken biriyani, hakka noddles, panner butter masala, mix veg korma.

Desserts - only gulab jamun, vanilla flavored ice cream and moong dal halwa.

I think it was an ok kind of place and might not visit again. They don't do justice to the price we pay for the buffet.

My overall ratings:
Food - 3/5

Will be back soon as I stay just round the corner!

Overall good place among all the high rated modern restaurants in Church Street.

This is one of the best Andhra food available in Bangalore. This chain of restaurants is in Bangalore for at least 20+ years. We had tried Andhra Meals and Chicken Biryani (this particular visit) . These are a must try if you like spicy food. Been visiting this place for many years and i can surely say their quality of food hasn't dropped a notch. Vehicle parking is a challenge in Church Street. So plan accordingly.

Bheema's is a Andhra style cusine, located on the church street. Open for lunch and dinner, mutton Biryani, chilli chicken, lemon chicken, fish fry are a must try for all the non veg lovers. And for veg lovers, veg biriyani is equally good and the unlimited Andhra meals is quite good. Others starters that I have tried here is chilli Gobi, chilli paneer, omlete. They do have a parking facility for 4 wheeler which is limited just to 2 cars.

Now why do most of my old haunts disappoint me. I guess there is a kind of romance, if one may call it, that never re-lights itself.
The three-generations went over for lunch - in high anticipation of the meal and the biryani. Somehow the taste was different. And though we were all full to the gills, that sense of a hearty meal was missing. Of non-veg items - the lemon chicken was totally disappointing, the sholay kabab made amends.
I must say the service was, as in the past, very friendly and attentive. That was the biggest positive.

If they can work in variety then it would be really great

My husband and I visited this place just after Christmas and tried their special menu. This was a nice experience and the whole menu was overall amazing.

This is a hidden place on the kamanahalli road (the straight road of sena vihar), this place is before sena vihar on the left hand lane. Superb ambience and delicious menu. Food is really very good. Khao suey was very good.

Had a great time with family and very good food @ OKI. It's a neighborhood eatery I have been planning on visiting since it opened and finally it happened. Nothing like the name suggests, this place has some really good food and a better than average ambience.
Food is definately a highlight here. Asian at its heart, this place a wide variety to choose from. Unlike the traditional menus where appetizers and mains are divided into separate sections, here the me u has a mix of food based on the portion sizes.
Staff is good and very prompt.
Parking may be an issue as they do not have a valley service.
Do try their wild mushroom and sun-dried tomatoes soup, Thai basil noodles chicken with black chilli tamarind and basil sause

Place was quite empty when we popped in for dinner. Interesting decor and ambiance. It was raining outside so the bright interiors were quite a contrast. 
Nice seating options and a bar in one corner. 
The waiter seemed attentive and friendly. 
We ordered some pork ribs, Cambodian fish curry with rice and Lamb Rendang. 
Pork ribs were good
Cambodian Grilled Red Snapper was okay.
Lamb Rendang was delicious.
Most of the dishes were above the 250 range and though there were a lot of Asian options, I felt the European dishes were limited. 
Overall, attentive service and a nice space for a relaxed dinner with plenty of dishes to choose from.

Charming little Asian restaurant. Lovely ambience, friendly and prompt service. I loved the sticky pork ribs... Yum! The lamb rendang was cooked beautifully with an orange colour chutney type thing which had some fiery kick to it! Definitely recommend.

I came here on Sunday evening for a dinner. The place looks cozy and nice, more like a family diner. As I was sitting there, I saw only big families coming. They are not serving alcohol but the mocktails are looking great.
It was a nice surprise, that they have weekend special menu, which includes my favorite sushi.
I ordered cranberry mohito, smoked salmon sushi, and margarita pizza.
Mohito was good. Sushi were very tasty. Pizza was ok ok. Truly it's better to go for fried rice and Asian meals since it's their specialty.
I will come back to try Tom yum soup.

In a small farm off a "busy in office times" road in Whitefield, a difficult to notice cafe - Bistro Boulevard.

I have been here twice and on weekends for a quick brunch.

Coming here again to try their dinner and enjoy the ambience at night.

it's nt those fancy new food outlets in Bangalore.. they serve the most authentic muslim cusine food..... Tastes like homely.. the Biryani ,Paya , nihari were off the roof.. please try nihari and paya with sheermal buns. Must visit and on my regular list now.

Ordered a full Nalli Nihari from their new CV Raman Outlet through Swiggy. It was the best mutton curry that I've ever had, hands down. The Mutton was fall apart tender and the flavours were spot on.

I will regularly place orders with them, so hope they maintain the same quality and consistency! Can't wait to try their other items.

PS - Please add Mutton Seekh Kebab to your CV Raman Nagar branch Swiggy menu.

The Ambiance of the place was really good although small, it made us feel like we were in the Mughal(s) time. At once, I guess this outlet can house only 10 customers of a group of 6 - 7 . But That we understand , because Koramangala JNC Does get pretty crowded ! Okay so the next thing that I absolutely loved was the menu categorization , the cooking style was mentioned in the menu and we knew exactly how the 'pakwaan' would be. Nice touch ! Okay so coming to the order , we had patthar ghost which was stone cooked mutton and a large boneless murgh ka biryani. Now guys please don't be fooled by the pricing they have given - because the quantity is pretty less , you may end up ordering to less if you are going in a big group. Do order the large to ensure you don't fall short. Even the starters - quantity wise is pretty less! So do be careful. This was not mentioned in any other review I've seen of this place . 

Food : 3/5
Ambiance : 4/5
Service : 3.5/5

Enjoyed a delicious afternoon meal at this Arabian restaurant..!
Heard this place is famous for biryani, but I liked the chicken shorba much more than the biryani..!

One place to satisfy your noodle cravings! Located amongst the most popular restaurants in Koramangala, you can easily miss this. Food is amazing. A little oily, but what's noodles without a little shine, right? The customisation they do is great. You get to decide what goes in your noodles and the size too. We ordered a Noodle Box. Veg options are limited, but good, you get to try out combinations of sauces, vegetables and noodle base. The staff are very patient in explaining what each of them means (they have noodle options basis what they are made of- maida, wheat, whole wheat, etc) and what their sauces taste like (Schezwan is the only one we might know in the menu). Overall, great food.

I saw this restaurant many times whenever I passed by and thought another new Chinese restaurant in the same area. Bubble tea is too good. I tried classic bubble tea and cranberry bubble tea with tapioca bubbles.

Apart from that the onion rings were good too.

Let me be frank, I love Kun fu panda and ever since then I just love Panda. While I was walking in Koramangala I saw this restaurant which was themed Panda. Without a second thought, I visited this restaurant. 

Ambiance: As the name says the restaurant is panda-themed. Every element in the restaurant is so adorable with panda pictures hanged on the wall and a few dishes made in the shape of a panda.

We ordered,
 Pad Thai - This was amazing! The Tangier Pad Thai can be made spicy with added chili flakes.
Thai Red curry - Heavenly! And a plus point for the lovely panda garnishing of Jasmine. Cuteness overloaded. The best Thai curry I had in recent times. 
Noodle box - Black Bean in Udon - I loved this Noodle box which completes my meal. This was on a spicy side and tasted amazing.
Fudgy Cookie ice cream with Oreo was definitely a show stopper.

Overall, this is another great place at Koramangala would make your day with great food and adorable panda all around.

Honey Dew with Melon cucumber drink - cooling!

Udan Noodle Box - non veg - burrp! Its filling.

Service- good
Ambience - good
Food taste - very good

When craving crunch, spicy and noodles, Noodle Panda is your place to go! 
We tried onion rings, katsu chicken bao and MYO noodles... food was yumm. Especially the onion rings, amazingly crisp and light. Noodle panda has everything with panda and the bao serving wrap was the cutest thing ever!!! Hats off to the ingenuity. The menu has loads to offer and I have my heart set on the wasabi centre chicken wings for next round already!! Looks absolutely mouth-watering on the plate of my neighbour :

Let me be frank, I love Kun fu panda and ever since then I just love Panda. While I was walking in Koramangala I saw this restaurant which was themed Panda. Without a second thought, I visited this restaurant. 

Ambiance: As the name says the restaurant is panda-themed. Every element in the restaurant is so adorable with panda pictures hanged on the wall and a few dishes made in the shape of a panda.

We ordered,
 Pad Thai - This was amazing! The Tangier Pad Thai can be made spicy with added chili flakes.
Thai Red curry - Heavenly! And a plus point for the lovely panda garnishing of Jasmine. Cuteness overloaded. The best Thai curry I had in recent times. 
Noodle box - Black Bean in Udon - I loved this Noodle box which completes my meal. This was on a spicy side and tasted amazing.
Fudgy Cookie ice cream with Oreo was definitely a show stopper.

Overall, this is another great place at Koramangala would make your day with great food and adorable panda all around.

New outlet in the locality of koramangala.

Honey Dew with Melon cucumber drink - cooling!
Watermelon and basil drink - Refreshing!
Spicy Dan Dan Noodles with chicken and prawns - slurpy noodles with chunks of meat of ur choice.
Udan Noodle Box - non veg - burrp! Its filling.

Service- good
Ambience - good
Food taste - very good
Food quantity/quality - sufficient for one!
Will come back here again? - Yes

After a hectic day which involved walking around the streets of Bengaluru and exploring different places, was when hunger set in. One of my friends suggested the Karama Restaurant and we walked 2 miles to get there! And it was worth it! Although there were enough seating places, the restaurant was jam packed and we were lucky to get the last table available. The restaurant had a nice ambience. They serve Punjabi, Arabian and Karachi cuisine. We ordered Karachi Naan, Chicken Bhuna Tawa and half Mandi Biryani.
Quantity :The quantity served was huge!. The quantity of biryani provided can easily serve 3 people. The Karachi Naan was atleast 5 times bugger than the regular Naan.
The Chicken Buna Tawa was lip smacking
and is sufficient for three people.
The prices were reasonable. The staff was courteous. And the service was quick.
Definitely recommend this restaurant!

Place doesn't have any music as such overall they offer different ways for sitting while you relish your meal. Like for a big group , there is small couch sort off place to sit like without chair table. Location; convenient, right on the main road in Frazer town.
Excellent food and I would love to visit here again if I have a plan to go Bangalore. This is similar to a fine dining experience. Though they are a little slow in service but very nice !

We had tried Nalli nihari (Arabian non veg curry) and special chicken kabab with rotis.

Nalli nihari is very rare available food in bangalore which take more than a day to prepare it. And staff in this restaurant explain you as well that how they have prepared it and history of food migration.

Ambience is turkey styled and very different from conventional interior. It feels like you are in some night life Arabian place.

Food is delicious and quantity is good enough. Would suggest this place for date, family food time and late night grabs. This restaurant is open till 1.30AM. Visiting this during ramzan is more special.

For starters we had Sheesh Tawook, Mixed BBQ platter, Paneer Tikka and Dahi Kabab. The Dahi Kabab and Sheesh Tawook were great! The paneer was slightly hard.

For main course we got Karama Mutton Mandi, the rice wasn?t as flavourful as it is in Biriyani so I?d prefer biriyani over this. We also had Chicken Rara, Paneer Makhani and Butter Garlic Naan, all of these were delicious!

Ambience wise this is a running stand eat and go kind of setup. But for that setup their pricing is on the higher end and that is the reason they do not score high.

Dosas here are made in white butter and the masala in their dosa is Davanagere style - a little plain as compared to other restaurants. But the crispiness of the dosa, the taste of white butter and the spice in the coconut chutney make up for the bland masala.

I really liked their cocktails coz of their presentation and preparation.

Never miss out the dish called notorious pig. It's delicious.

Among the cocktails I loved their LIT. (long Island ice tea) and moonshine , and social special margarita.

Ambience are always vibrant and jolly.

Really liked the ambience,food and music

We went to this social after a very very long time. Maybe after 3-4yrs. Landed here for our Sunday breakfast.
We went in for the saddleggs, Kiran's big apple and Sid's posh breakfast.
Everything was great, especially the berry compote with the pancakes is delicious.
The ambience and the music was perfect for our morning today!
Only criticism being the service, once the place got a little crowded, it was difficult getting anything. It took around 25 mins for the cheque post asking two people.
Overall good experience.
Food: 4.5/5
Ambience: 4/5
Service: 3.5/5
Value for money: 4/5

Wonderful ambience and food. The Chicken lollipops were truly amazing. The sides were filling with the omelette and the caramel peanut being the star.
A hot bowl of ramen , a perfect comfort food for your soul.

This was my recent weekend food joint! I was craving for a big bowl of ramen and decided to give it a try. How happy I was to find out they have the best combo ever - spicy ramen + gimbap ! And the sides were delicious too. The peanuts in caramel sauce were the best. Ate to my heart's content ! HAPPY TUMMY, HAPPY ME !

Impressed !!! 

The bibimbap was perfect. Kimchi lovers paradise. We tried the Gimbap and it was truly a delight. 
Very friendly staff , simple ambience , they have an outdoor seating as well. Reasonably priced. Plus they have good coffee & good wine . Must visit if you love Korean. Hi Seoul.

I hit this place to try Korean cuisine for the first time and Hi Seoul has left a huge first impression. I have become sort of a fan of Korean food. I have never eaten Korean food before so can't really comment on authenticity though it felt pretty authentic.

We tried Bibimbap, Deopbap, Seaweed Wrap, Korean Chicken Lollypop and all were amazing.

The place has indoor and open seating area. It seemed a little understaffed but the staff were very warm and friendly.

It is totally worth the money and the evening.

One of the few times I've ever been to a restaurant, tried a completely different cuisine and loved everything I ordered. The staff was pleasant and helpful too in trying to help us decide what to order.Will definitely go back there and also recommend it to my friends.

I've been staying just a few streets away, and it's a shame I didn't know a place such as this even existed!

What I love about Hi Seoul, is the fact that it's a nice, simple restaurant where the focus is just on good food. Awesome staff. V.good soupy noodles. They prepare some really kickass beef dishes. And their pork is definitely worth a try. I've just not managed to learn the names of dishes yet though ;) But, this place deserves a total thumbsup!

Hi Seoul was my second experience of Korean food and i definitely wasn't disappointed. We were four of us and made sure we tried as much as we could. 

The chicken wings were great, but i missed the word sweet when we ordered. If you have a liking to sweet stuff, you would love this. Gimbap is my new favourite and i was quick to order one. This could have been better but good nonetheless. Bimbimbap is a must have at any Korean restaurant and we too didn't want to miss it. I loved it. We also ordered the BBQ pork, the one they claim is from Canada. This one i felt was not value for money. Just pan fried pork which we had with some leftover sauce of the chicken. The exciting part was that it was fried at our table. 

We also ordered another pork dish that came with the sticky rice. Another dish that went very well with my Indian palette. The accompaniments on the table definitely  need a mention. They could be meal if not shared.

This was authentic Korean and tasted very similar you what I ate in Korea.

Authentic Korean food is pretty difficult to find... Hi Seoul changed my opinion about that.Very quaint and simple restaurant.The waiters are very sweet & friendly.
We ordered :
Chicken lollipop - 4.5/5, it was a little on the sweeter side... but crisp and delicious.
Gimbap Seaweed rolls - 4/5 my husband liked it, I am not a seaweed fan so didn't enjoy it quite that much. Recommended if you are a fan of sushi...
Pajeon (Korean pancake) - 4/5 very different, authentic Korean food, never had it before. It was good,cooked well.
Osam Bulgogi - 5/5 loooveddd it!! Definitely recommended... it had just the right amount of spice & super yum.

The portions are pretty large, two people can easily share all the dishes. We had to carry home leftovers,couldn't finish them.

Definitely visit if you want to have authentic Korean food :)

Hands down the best Korean restaurant here. The staff is extremely cordial. The portions they provide give justice to their prices. The amount of complementary veggies and dips was exorbitant. You must try the pork here, it's delicious. The slices of complementary watermelon at the end won our heart. Do visit here for a fine Korean experience.

Before you set foot here, throw away all expectations and preconceived notions, unless you carry them from real South korea. Go with an open mind.
Now the ambience is lovely, very homely and comfortable. K pop plays softly in the background. The staff is very friendly, courteous and attentive.
I love the sides they serve and the kimchi is pretty good. I've made kimchi with green cabbage from korean blogs before(I had to struggle to get the gochujang) so there I know what I'm eating. My friend ordered veg Gimbap that I didn't like much, but she loved. The dipping sauce is yummy.
I ordered the Dolsot Bibimbap and it was interesting. A little bland for my chutney and chilli palate but good portion and filling. My friend liked the kimchi fried rice.
It is not very Indianised , which is good for authenticity.
The experience overall is good and I look forward to trying more of their fare. If you want a slice of south Korea at an affordable rate, this is your best bet.

Hi Seoul is a small homely restaurant in Kalyanagara which offers delicious Korean food. The restaurant may not look like a five star restaurant but it is a calm and quite place where you can spend your time with your friends and family.

Must try - Gimbap, Osam bulgogi, Chicken lollipops. I loved the Gimbaps.
Along with the food you can order a wine.

Best Korean food in Bangalore. Great ambiance smiling staff who are there to help you out in every manner. Best food quality within your wallet. What more to say about this place. Please visit if you wish to taste good Korean food.

All in one meal - Bibimbap

Bibimbap is simply a bowl of rice that is mixed with various kinds of vegetables, together with mushrooms, a fried egg, and ground meat, and seasoned with red chili pepper paste. A dribble of sesame oil can adds to its savory taste.
It served in a hot pot with the rice sticking to the pot is crispy and golden fried which when mixed along with all ingredients tastes heavenly.

Bulgogi - deopbap Chicken gravy served with sticky rice this gravy was very Indianized but it was good.

Ambiance : Is decent enough ,i ts a house converted into a restaurant with outdoor seating and private seating in each rooms for families.

Verdict : Bibimbap

Hi Seoul!!!!! Never ever again.  Either Korean Food is not my taste or the food was actually very bland. 
1 point only for the Nakji Bokkeum (Octopus and vegetables , stir fried in red chilli sauce), as this dish was better compared to others. What we ordered was : Jap-chae,  deep fried chicken wings ( very sweet- not my taste)  and nakji bokkeum, followed by side dishes.
Great food, excellent service, and good ambience. We had 'Jeyuk Bokkeum' and 'Bulgogi Deopbap'. We liked it and recommend them too. They explained how to have them too.
If I have to sum up my experience at Hi Seoul... Amazing Food. Polite folks. Awesome Presentation. Great Value for money.

Very homely and unassuming place but the food is something else. We have dined at Soo Ra Sang... but feel the food here is light years ahead. This place is run by a middle aged Korean couple and the wife is the chef and cooks herself. Pricing is fair while quantities are fairly big with loads of meat in every bite. Coupled with a friendly host who helps you with your ordering, makes for a good dining experience.

If you are looking for scrumptious Korean food Hi Seol is the place to visit in Bangalore. We have gone there twice now in the last 3 weeks - Simply delicious Korean fare !!

Punjabi Swag is a North Indian dhaba style place that offers very good Punjabi food items. The ambience is truly of a dhaba and also the music played there is very lively. I have tried a number of items but their Butter Chicken definitely stands out. It is awesome and a must-try item. Masala Papas, Garlic Naan, and Cuole Kulche are also tasty. Service is slow and needs to be improved. They keep the restaurant open till late in the night so it's a good choice for the late night cravings.

Today I visited panjabi swag. Place was so amazing, full of panjabi flavours, spices. And that aroma of ingredients was mind blowing. Hat's off to chef because he knows how to put spices perfectly aand how to balance dish. That creaminess, spiciness of chaap was outstanding. Sarso ka saag was perfectly balanced and full of flavours and when you will take a bite of sarso ka saag with makke ki rooti you will feel like you are in panjab. And I had best dalmakhni of my life. And about my favourite part dessert, Without dessert there is nothing in life and that gajar ka halwa was literally too good. Nice ambiance you will feel like you are in panjab. Great hospitality!!! At last if food will put a smile on your face that food deserves more than 10 rating. Thank you panjabi swag you guys made my day!!!!

Found a great outlet to have some great North Indian Punjabi style food. Menu is short and concise but they have done a great job in making food delicious. Sarson ka saag and makke ki roti made my day along with paneer tikka as a starter. Staff was great, friendly and service was really fast.

I ordered Malai Chaap and some Paneer dish from this restaurant few days ago. It was ok in taste. So we thought to try the Chaap again with Chicken Tikka as this is a punjabi again.
Then after ordering from here via Swiggy, my concept of trying every Punjabi Restaurant in Bangalore, got changed.
I ordered Achaari Chaap and Chicken Tikka today. The achaari chaap was boiled and mixed with Achaar masala(from the achaar we found in Supermarket) and Chicken Tikka was not cooked well.
@Restaurant: If you want to check how to cook Chaap, then go to Gurgaon/Noida. You will definitely learn how to make Tandoori chaap/Malai Chaap/Masala Chaap/Hariyali Chaap/Achaari Chaap. Also visit Delhi in between to learn Chicken Tikka.
For Chicken Tikka, You can also visit Khan Saheb outlet in Jayanagar.
So its an advice: If you will cook better, then we will share your positive reviews otherwise will definitely share your bad reviews.

Great thalis with different varieties will never let you get bored, trust me! Worth a try!

The address in incorrectly marked up in the map. Its nearer to btm water tank. Coming to the food its a simple menu but great to taste. They have different varieties of sabzi everyday and it serves up well to people like me who like homely food at pocket friendly rate.

No words to describe this mini Restaurant... Simply AWESOME...
Each day comes with a bunch of Different options/varieties...
So, this place has become our daily dinner joint....
Serving 2 different varieties of Vegetables n Dal and Hot tawa chapaties, reminds me of my Homemade food...
Tongue twister options available are Dal Makhani, Kofta, Pakoda Kadi, Matar Paneer, Egg Curry etc...
Moreover, I would advise everyone to try this out atleast once to relish the home cooked food...

It's a food which is just like homemade and you can rely on , in emergency cases or as daily dinner if you cannot cook/ or your wife is out of town.
Not counting bachelors as that's by default you can find them grabbing bite.
About food: Great lassi, awesome parantha and ok thali..
Best thing : tasty homemade taste

I used to have food here for 6 months, then shifted to JP Nagar 7th Phase(approx 5km) but still this is my food point for weekends.

This is a a typical punjabi place...no fuss, hole in the wall setting and home made simple food.

They have a standard fare of dal, chappati, sabzi/s and chawal, served twice all days of the week. The establishment is hygienic and the people who serve are very hospitable.

Good place for a hearty and filling meal.

I am rating this place 4 for the reason that it is one of  the most honest eateries out there in BTM. They don't try anything fancy, just basic meals for 3 times a day and they do it pretty good, the meals are usually set, choose between dal, the gravy of the day and the dry veggie of the day, during lunch and dinner you can get Egg Curry and Chicken as well, but again nothing fancy there, basic preparation. you take what you get. Which is a good thing, because you land up at this place looking for good North Indian fare, low on the wallet, basically your regular meals. And they make it relatively oil free, so that scores a big plus with me! I have frequented this place for more than 4-5 months and never got bored and yeah the staff is nice and courteous, you will find them making good relationships with each customer that walks in :)

Went here on a sunday morning while looking for a place to have good parathas. Wasn't disappointed. Though the place might not seem hygienic to many people but the parathas were tasty and lassi was also great. Would recommend to anyone who likes parathas and lassi. A nice place to have your weekend breakfasts.

Cheap and tasty north Indian food. The Pooris are deliciously light though only available on Sundays.

Cute little place in noisy Koramangala.

Pocket-friendly.

This is one of my favorite hangouts. My current favorite: cinnamon tea.

It?s a fantastic place for a quick bite and some wonderful refreshing drinks. The food is extremely tasty and all of it is very affordable. I find myself at break time brew several times a week. This place is a must try .

Never disappointed me in the quality of food
Small place but still the ambience was fabulous. I haven't tried any food but different coffees and cookies. A perfect place for break time.
I loved the ginger tea and choco chip cookies that I had at Breaktime brew. So affordable that it doesn't even pinch the pockets and I absolutely love the quirky decor!

But it's located in a nice place. And the food here is epic.
For the price you pay(15 per roti/holige) can't really ask for more.
Food is prepared right in front of you & the vegetable gravy, podi chutney & chutney add to the taste.
Everything has the taste of homemade food & is really healthy.

Was having tea at the stall next to this place when I saw someone ordering North Karnataka food. so I impulsively ordered to take-away too.
10 Jola Rotti and 2 side dishes.
The Jola Rotti was as authentic as it could get. of the 2 sides ,the eggplant dish which goes best with Jola Rotti was :-( . ...a let-down. The dish with pulses was delicious.
The place also had a live-station with Akki,Raagi and other Rottis being served hot from the Tava.
will try to taste those too,soon.
Just a little bigger than a Hole-in-the-wall kind of operation, but worth a try.

Had akki roti and ragi roti with rajma masala.. Real good taste for the price of ?15 per roti.. Also ordered masala rice which was not good - rice was not well cooked..
Go to this place for the rotis - they're real good !!

This place didn't look like a eatery. They sell akki roti, jowar roti, ragi roti, holige with three different curries. I took akki roti with gravy. It was yum. For 15rs. The taste n the quality and quantity of food is awesome. Holige with lot of stuffings in it makes it super yum. Ragi roti is good as well. You can get this items hot served. Cheap n best. Try it if u love north Karnataka Roti's.

I ordered a cake to be delivered to my office for the celebration. Sadly the cake(Rs 700 + tip for 500gm) was smashed upto 60% and of no use. Packing was extremely bad from the cafe. The regular bakery's pack the cakes in a good cardboard box.  After reaching out to Zomato support and putting this review with 1 star I got back Rs 325(I put 3 star now) but had to buy another one outside.
Taste of the cake was good.
We bought german chocolate cake today for new year celebration in our office. Its very tasty. I loved the taste of chocolate over all 5/5...
The pineapple pastry which was ordered for my birthday celebration was really good. Soft, perfect icing with pineapple pieces and would just melt in your mouth.

Ordered a Pineapple cake today for a birthday because I was truly tired of the chocolate variants everywhere. Was quite surprised that it was SO good! Had to make a mention of it on Zomato. The cake was filled with syrup, and a pineapple gel on top with vanilla/meringue buttercream and white chocolate shavings! Every bite was delightful.

Try this over chocolate variants for a change.
This place serves amazing cakes, cupcakes, brownies and all. I always order birthday cakes from this place. Death by chocolate cake is a must try, its very yum.

Excellent service and good ambience. A very chill place go to after college and hangout with friends. The caterers Bhavya and Ryan were very co operative and helpful. I would definitely recommend this place for good food and hospitality.

The food is absolutely wonderful, from preparation to presentation, very pleasing.
Great food at a great price!
Definitely worth many more visits in the future!

Ordered a cappuccino and a bowl of Maggi which was served to me by the polite guys who work here. Really loved the evening vibe here. Must try especially if you're a Christite looking out for places to chill, around SG Palya.

you can try once in while
Very nice food. Especially Malabar cuisine.

food is really good here...

Don't know about the food... It's probably a bachelor's paradise but I didn't want to risk an upset stomach after walking into this place. It's filthy! Dirty Floors and tables so I wonder what the scene in the kitchen's like? Shivers!

Got to know about this restaurant through Zomato gold. So, decided to give it a try on a special occasion in our family.

Good ambience for a group dine-in, multicuisine options are available with quick servicing staffs. Main highlight is the owner / manager who's hospitality. He greeted us and gave as a comfortable seating. He explained us the dishes and took the orders with our customizations. He was polite and patient to listen to us and our requirements.

Tried noodle pepper sea food soup, chilli prawns, prawn sukka (Mangalorean style made of coconut and coconut oil), garlic roti, mutton gosh, Hyderabadi chicken biryani cooked in clay pot, guava jack and strawberry mocktail.

All the dishes were good. I liked the strawberry mocktail a lot and guava jack was spicy with green chilli and masala powder.

Great experience overall. Recommended for multicuisine lovers with groups.

My friend brought me here. Ordered Hyd biryani egg biryani and Golden banana fish.....Wooow...awesome....esp hyd biryani loved it to the core....I suggest ppl who loves biryani to visit this plc.......

Awesome food
Great taste
Somany varieties
Must visit twice or trice..
We tried chicken, lamb, fish and pasta.
All were finger licking good
Especially lamb was at its best.

One of the rarest restaurant in Bangalore where each dish is a delight , from soup to desert every bite gave satisfaction to the core . We went to this place on our engagement anniversary , manager is knows all the details of the menu and preparations and helped us order right.
Chicken sweet corn soup was so perfect ...not over sweet like other places. For starters the banana wrap fish couldn't have been better than this , right spices properly cooked. Chicken lasuni tikka had nice creamy gravy with garlic and juicy chicken ,for main course . Last meal was desert ... Strawberry Pana Cotta had just the right amount of sweetness and very nice texture. Staff is well trained and overall was a great dining experience.

This has become my favourite place with regular visits... ambience is so nice and peaceful... great food at economical price... plus staff is very good, especially the manager who greats everyone with his sweet smile n talks
Nothing great about this place. Food is average and drinks are over priced. We only liked the soups- Manchow and Basil. Service is good but nothing extraordinary.

A place with mouthwatering food after a long time. Previously know as gotcha this place has real good revamped ambience. Coming to food..the menu is quite expansive. Seafood..noodles..sizzlers..mocktails there wasn't anything that tasted bad. Kudos. Portions are quite good and the best of all the people in there managing. The manager was extremely humble and accommodating. Highly recommended

The maitre d was very humble and friendly. Compliments to the chef and him.

-- Awesome food (coastal & continental).

-- Great ambiance.

Not many options were available in beverages other than soft drinks. A lot of options in chicken available, the recommended are :

Pulled Chicken Burger

Visited the Galito's outlet in Vegacity mall. Galito's proclaims to bring "BOLD AFRICAN FLAVOUR" to our city. Those who've visited Nando's can instantly relate to this place.

The food, the menu, the decor - they all reminded me of Nando's. I will however say that the service here is much better. Galito's' famed flame grilled chicken is "the bee's knees". The peri-peri sauce comes in 5 variants - Mild, Garlic, Hot, Lemon & Herb and Premium Reserve.

The grilled chicken breast in the peri-peri chicken burger could've been tenderized better. The chicken and veggie rice though was flavourful and wholesome.

The fiery pineapple mocktail was sublime. Just the right mix of sweet and heat. The mombo mint though was a little too thick in consistency.

Awesome place for a grub in vega city. They are comparatively cheaper then Nandos who serve similar food but the quality is at par!!! Also they have options like meals for 2, 4 and 6 wherein 1 can select drink, starter and main course. The only problem was we can order a mix of veg and non veg in these options, I hope the management would look into that

Trust me it was a good decision we made!!! The chicken here is to die for... The food is really good.. the only thing I found bad was the bun they used. It was a bit soggy they can use better ones.

Service 4/5

After a busy day, one would just want to relax with a quick hot meal. Chancing upon Firangi Bake, I quickly ordered a chicken steak. As the name suggests, Firangi Bake is essentially Indian cuisine fused with "phoren" flavours. The steak, grilled to perfection, arrived on a bed of fragrant and mildly spiced basmati rice. I feel the taste-buds would need to get used to this kind of combinations, but it was a treat anyway. Maybe the portion sizes and the pricing needs to be revisited by the establishment, but overall, a good experience.

If you are are cheese lover then Minced Chicken Lasagne is the right choice for you. In between two layers of cheese they fill minced chicken which has a tangy and juicy taste. It comes with a Kulcha. It is sufficient for one time meal.

Their Masala Chicken Quesadilla is filled with spicy chicken chunks and tastes good. The Quesadilla is crispy outside.

Though I'm not a fan of Mexican food but Firangi bake has their own touch of desi flavours that makes their food cherishable.

Firangi Bake is an only delivery service at Bangalore, that has a limited menu of lasagne, rice, and steak - but serves fusion food. We tried their minced chicken lasagne and chicken pot rice - both of which were ample in quantity. The food is well packaged as well and delivery is made on time. The pot rice was excellent in taste, but my favourite was definitely the lasagne - the layers of cheese that were melting through my mouth was definitely satisfying! Cost for two is around 500, and a meal here is definitely worth it.

As the name says it, Firangi Bake has a fusion of the Italian with the Indian cuisine. The quantity is pretty less for the price but the flavor is delicious and worth it. The food was packed very neat.
Minced Chicken Lasagna
Rating : 4.5/5
Tandoori kukkad pot rice
Rating : 4/5
The food, I must say, was brilliant.

Firstly we would like to thank Firangi Bake for choosing us for the food tasting and reviewing program. We chose-

1) Chicken Keema Lasagne (Minced Chicken Lasagne): This layered beauty was all Italian outside and truly Indian on the inside! The top gooey layer of cheese alongwith the minced chicken fillings coated with the perfect amount of Indian spices was adding a new dimension to this masterpiece!

2) Tandoori Kukkad Pot Rice (Pot Rice with an Indian twist): This one pot meal does justice to all the Indian flavours added to it. The North Indian Tandoori Kukkad here is seen to blend perfectly with the rice while the top layer of cheese unifies the two into a marvelous creation.

It is an amazing platform that brings freshly baked global cuisines with a 'desi dhadak'!

Firangi bake is a fresh taste to the palettes with the twist of desi dishes with videshi feels!

Small, cosy, covered rooftop place provides just the right menu for quick bites as well as main course.

The view is pretty in the evenings due to glass walls. The ambience is good for a small gathering and hang out. Not exactly the kind of place for fine dining.

It doesn't seem to be like a popular hang out. It is hard to even know if a cafe is existing there.

Having Zomato gold membership works out well. It was due to that we identified the place and went till there to utilise the benefit. Thank you Zomato for the Gold :-) !!

We tried Veg Steak, pasta, pizza and sizzler.
They provide thin crust pizza. All the dishes were good and we enjoyed the food.

Giving 4 because the service was slower than expected. It could improve.

All in all its a quiet place and food price is slightly on the higher side considering the ambience and quantity but it's worth it since it tastes good. One could give it a try.

Small cozy rooftop cafe with a wide spread menu. Not the place for a huge gang. Service is as expected. Dishes to try are the range of pizza's. Went out to try their burgers and they were pretty good. The ambience was that of a rustic pub and the people are nice. The service is pretty slow.
Food - 3.5/5
Ambience - 4/5
Service - 3.5/5

A small roof top cafe on the main road.
Went around 1pm and we were the only people but later came some 7 to 8 people in another 30 minutes.
Ordered 2 chicken burgers,which was really good.
Service is great.
Ambience is cool and fruit beer is alos available here.

Penthouse Cafe is located in Banashankari. It's on the 4th floor and is right opposite to Cafe Coffee Day on the main road. First, the place seems really shady. The entrance is weird and you feel better only after ending up on the 4th floor.
The place is really tiny and seems good. Only thing that seemed nice about the place. We had the Nachos, cheese and salsa. The mayo along with this was so runny and milky. The cheese was only on the top layer and the below ones didn't have any. Next up, my friend and I tried the pink sauce pasta. The pasta was overcooked. The sauce wasn't creamy at all. It lacked in taste. It had garlic bread along with it and it tasted decently. But highly disappointed with this place. I took my friend to this place, with a lot of expectations and we were disappointed!

Situated in upper floor this cafe wasn't much known to me if I wouldn't find it in zomato. It was bit early when we entered hence there were hardly 2-4 ppl in the cafe. A small call place it was with light music. We had ordered veg pasta, BBQ chicken wings, Peri Peri pizza. All tasted good. Pasta could be better. Service was good.

Best place to have food and a very friendly staffed cafe... Price is very reasonable and the drinks are really really amazing .... No comments of this cafe as everything was very good...they also have a smoking zone....

Disappointing! A friend of mine had told me its a below average cafe, but I did not believe it looking at the ratings. Visited myself today and he was right. Masala tea was not even brewed and was made out of tea bags which was priced at 120 Rs. Left it after two sips.

Pesto Garlic bread was average but was priced at 200 Rs! Virgin mojito tasted like it was just sweet sugar syrup with a hint of lime.

Overall not worth the price being charged for the quality of food. Not sure about their other food items as i did not even wanted to venture further when the tea arrived.

3.5 would be the actual rating but would not like to discourage hence 4. There are much better options available surrounded. The place again a rooftop convert to a restaurant, small well done interiors for its type and nice lighting and good view from top during evening... Tried sizzler and rice both were average nothing much to say but okay as an alternative, price not match for what we get...

A casual and not very expensive dining place in Banashanki which is not very hard to locate.
It is a rooftop cafe in the fourth floor giving it a amazing view.

We ordered the Nachos Cheese Salsa, BBQ Chicken Grilled Burger and the 'must try' Jalapeno Cottage Cheese Burger.

The Nachos were good and I loved the sauce they gave it with.
The burgers where really sloppy but super filling in which the BBQ Chicken Grilled Burger was good, quite similar to any other BBQ burgers.
But the 'must try' Jalapeno Cottage Cheese Burger is something I wouldn't recommend.

Overall they have a great ambiance and an okayish food.

Peace.

Easily located. The cafe is on the last floor of the building with cute ambience. Me and my friends went here for some evening coffee and chit chats. It's perfect for catching up friends over a coffee.

We ordered Hot chocolate and Mocha Latte. Mocha Latte was good, had a perfect blend of chocolate and coffee. Hot chocolate on the other than was decent nothing extraordinary.

Staff was friendly and courteous.

Would visit to try more.

Great place with some great food and booze. The amazing part about this place is the ambience and the peace in which you can have a drink and food with your friends, talk for long and live in the nostalgia. The corn fritters was pretty good but expected a little more corn in it.

I loved the contemporary rustic theme that they applied to this place and the dictionary art print wallpaper was hip and trendy. The blend of old and new furnishings was innovative especially the cute little chandeliers hanging off of the wooden beams in the smoking zone. The orange capriosca that I had was very delicious and so were the quesadillas and corn fritters. The food was overall good. The staff was polite, friendly and attentive. Hope they continue to maintain this pace. The music playlist also was a fusion of all the genres which was quite refreshing. Altogether, a great place to experience some good food and drinks

Our go-to hangout for reasonable drinks and food at Kormangala is now at Residency road! The ambience is quirky, and as I was told, it has been so made that it resembles a place which was designed by a Drunk writer! Like I said, Quirky.

The lighting is low, and the space is not huge, but the lovely open bar is a welcome relief. They have some interesting signature cocktails. My picks would be Summer's coming(A gin cocktail with watermelon, and sparkling wine) and Blossoms of Paradise(White Rum, chocolate bitters and mint).

The food is also pretty good and they have the classics such as crumb Fried Prawns, Chicken Satay and a few new ones like Pork Cheesy Potato Skins and Kaffir Lime Chicken Tikka.

Overall, a pleasant experience, and its a good option in this area given the price-point and quality of food. Check it Out!
