They have a variety of dosas, idli and other stuff along with meals. 

I have not tried the sandwiches and chaat so cannot comment about those.
Decent biryani with 2 pieces kabab, gravy and salad. There was no sweet in the delivered pack though the description of combo included a sweet as well.

kundana...... we went for a movie to vegacity and was searching for a typical andhra lunch and could found kundans board appearing nearby and finally we went there and ordered thali which was really Yum ? mostly the best was authentic mango and tomato pickle which was too good and was giving best company to the thalis a must visit place to have the authentic feel of Andhra.

I was not sure about this resturant, never heard of it. Thought to give it a try so ordered Chicken Dum Biryani.

It was surprisingly good, one of the best biryani. It was really yummy and the chicken was well cooked. Quantity of biryani rice was just right. It's a must try place for biryani lovers.

First point I have impressed with this restaurant is they have paid enough attention for spl instructions which we mention at the time of placing order... am not sure abt this can happen in everybody case but its happen with me.... Coming to taste its quite good and andhra reason people can enjoy thoroughly am talking abt veg dishes related only.... NON-VEG is out-of-box 2 me... if any one reach near Vega city and that time if u feel u r starving then go and dig in...

The name shows it is a Andhra Cuisine Restaurant.
They are Andhra + Chinese + North Indian cuisine.
They serve one of the best Andhra Meals.
I havw tried their Biryani. Very nice biryani and much better than Meghana. The spices are different than regular biryani spicea.
They serve Rambo Biryani which is the best biryani i ever had.
They also serve Guntoor Chicken which was also very nice.
They also serve some Chinese dishesh which are really good.
I am their regular customer.
This place is definitely recommended for Andhra people. Much better option price wise than Nagarjuna and other restaurants.
Very good food without a big hole to pocket.
Overall everything is good here even the ambience.

This sunday was movie night and post movie we had dinner in Kundana. The restaurant was almost empty, we were welcomed with courtesy. Service was good and we ordered Paneer tikka, Mutton biryani, tandoori roti and lime soda. We were served complimentary papad and salad. Paneer tikka was tasty and green chutney was awesome. Mutton biryani was delicious and it had good pieces of mutton and rice quantity was enough for one person. Roti was hard and little difficult to eat. Ambience was nice and management does justice to the money paid. Overall if you looking for an andhra meal without burning your pocket, this is the place to be. Its in the first floor, walkable from vega city mall. Giving it a 3.5, hope they come with more branches.

New place so i ll start from wishing a good luck to them.
So we went their on a weekday, place was calm with decent crowd. We had lemon chicken, Chicken maharaja,Pepper chicken, Egg curry, paneer manchurian and chicken biryani.
All the items wer tasty. But, they need to work on the taste of chicken biryani.
Good service and ambience.
Quantity- value fr money

Have bookmarked this place since it was coming up. Had a chance to visit on Halloween. The event poster on zomato regarding Halloween looked quite promising although didn't turn out that great. The ambience is overall very general. Because of Halloween they kept the lights pretty low and the main source was candles nicely placed inside carved pumpkins. Some spooky decor here and there.

The service was good. About the food it was definitely the steal. I loved every bit of their food. Ordered for chilli chicken fried rice, chelo kebab, chicken kebab and lime soda. The chicken kebab was good enough too. The prices are also not very expensive. A definite visit if you're looking for a pocket friendly place with average ambience but great food.

Watson's is located just opposite to Mount Carmel grounds . Had been here on a Saturday night , we we're craving for some good food and found Watson's to be a good place . The ambience of the place is good and is nicely lit . Coming to the food we ordered the spicy mayo rock prawns , karepak vepedu and the stripped chilli chicken. I was drawn in by their claim of "All Day English Breakfast". The property was probably someone's house at some point, and the restaurant hasn't made any change to the structure. So the sitting arrangement is spread across three rooms, and the furniture ranged from wooden, to wicker to leather. This made for a very cozy, 'friend's house' ambiance.

The food was great and the wait was reasonable. There is a collection of books by the leather couch, which unfortunately is for display only, as several signs warn, but they do let you play the board games.

I wish the bathroom was a little more in keeping with the rest of the place, but it wasn't awful.

The people in the cafe were friendly and very polite. The prices are in keeping with the costs of most cafes around Bangalore, maybe slightly cheaper than some.

I will definitely come back.

waiting to visit for the next time..

The ambience of the place is really cozy and nice, even though it's a small place. The waffles are really affordable and tasty. Worth a visit.

The quality of the food is not great.

Awesome place to have breakfast at a very very economical price, the idli sambar is delicious , the puliyogre and lemon rice is lip smacking,try the combo, the fruit custard is awesome as well, it's very clean and u have millet dosa and rice for people who are dieting, however they can have more options in terms of roti or chapati,try it u will get addicted ...

Huge queues. Carry change. Also accepts paytm.

One of the most eco-friendly place I have seen. All the food is served on compressed eco plates. And banana leaves on top.

Serves chutney and sambar on the side which is self serve. The podi masala dosa is amazing! Literally the best you can have. May take a bit of getting used to though.

Serve a lot of options of millet dosa and millet Kara bath.

Super crowded. Any time of the day. Period.

Best budget friendly hote in this area. They do not have have enough space for dine in. You can go for daily meals. One meal or any bhat will cost you maximum 30 rupees. Taste is up to the mark and quantity as well. Great work. Keep it up guys.

Wow! This place is awesome and a very pocket friendly place. The place is well maintained, clean and hygienic despite the crowd.

We tried their kesari, dosa, chapathi and coffee.. Everything is awesome! Just served hot and fresh. Loved their coffee. Will be back for more!

Fresh, hot, amazing, authentic, Value for money.

Modest ambience but a hidden gem!
Courteous and friendly staff.
Piping hot ildy sambhar and tasty chutney.
Delectable tamarind rice preparation.

Must visit!

Simplicity, hygiene, taste and traditional food and at it's best. One of the best no frills breakfast place in HSR serving amazing and authentic, excellent quality pure ghee South Indian food. Steel benches make the seating arrangement, so find yourself a place, order, eat and scoop :)

This is my favourite breakfast place!!
Everything is fresh and hygienic. The staff is super quick and friendly and don't miss the filter coffee!

For approximately 60 Rs, you can walk away with a filled stomach. The menu is quite widespread and the waiting time for most items except the dosas is practically 30 seconds or less. Dosas take about 5 minutes to be prepared.
The quality of the food is good. Taste wise it isn't outstanding but I like it considering it tastes like home made food that has no artificial flavours. Keeping it simple was worked well for this restaurant.
The ambience isn't great but they do have a sufficient seating arrangement.
Service can be improved. It isn't exactly what you would call customer friendly.
Why you should visit? Because you get consistent good food at an affordable price.

Simplicity is what this place stands for , they serve authentic south indian food n yes i mean it you won?t find gobhi manchurian here ? ... we tried millet pongal ?khaira? and me being a diehard pongal lover was not sure how it will taste but it turned out to be one of the finest pongal i had , so we decided to try millet dosa , masala podi dosa and upma as well ... was not very impressed with millet dosa , however podi dosa n upma was amazing ?... ended up taking parcel for back home ?
You will get the best idli sambar here & the sambar filled with full of veggies.Zoom it and you will see it.Small and hygenic place for south indian breakfast.

A great budget place to eat as much as you want. All for cheap price. The rices, dosas are 30-40 bucks and they are so filling and tasty. Have been to this place more than 10 times. I had lemon rice, puligare rice, samabr rice, vadas, bondas. They were all tasty and worth every penny spent.

A nice place to have South Indian breakfast in her, they have nice idli sambhar and also we tried onion uttpam which was served with sagu. The place also serves very nice coffee. And it's very neatly maintained and hygenic too.

Small but quality arrangement
Tried their millet dosa ,ponhal, bisbelebath.Some not available at the time .
Please make sure u have everything in your menu.
I can understand the reason
I went twice to try different items.
Mini masala dosa also was good.
Recommended

Have been to this place multiple number of times as it is just located besides my house.

It is a darshini where they serve different types of dosa, idli vada and other south indian delicacies. The food in general is tasty.

The staff is quite friendly. Nothing to write about the ambience as it is a darshini.

The biggest point in favour of this place is that prices of food items are insanely cheap.

I ordered a eggless, creamless, and nutless cake on my daughter's birthday. I made specific instructions and I got one with thick cream. It was such a disappointment, almost like cheating where I was left with no option. They need better customer care.

Went to Daily bread for brunch today after giving my car for service at Maruti Suraksha. It is an decent place to hangout and value for money. I had a combo - Italian Panini and Cold coffee , and hubby had a Chicken salad. Overall good experience as we were super hungry. The service was good as we were the only customers in the place.

I always pick up the Banana Walnut cake and Marble Cake when I drop by this bakery.
Apart from that I feel the pastries are not really that great.

It just lives up to its name Daily Bread.
You can just drop by here to pick up your daily bread along with a few cupcakes and walnut brownies.

Try avoiding this outlet .overpriced. They claim to have varieties of bread but everything is the same.. We had to ask them to apply the combo , which was billed separately inspite of specifically ordering the combo. Service is extremely poor. They dint have stock of half the things and the staff were busy chit chatting with friends outside than attending to customers. Mochacchino coffee was good. Sugar donut was good. It ws soft and fresh. Other outlets are much better than this one.
Centrally located , needs more seating area ! Okayish for dessert. Loved the chocolate truffle bday cake I pre ordered even though they didn't customise the way I had specified

Ordered through swiggy.Chicken was dried up bit.Taste was not up to the mark.Delivery was on time.Quantity was top notch.Overall i may think twice before place the order.

The place complements the name it has, the service is amazing fast. The food is average but ok. An aspect which needs an improvement is the hygiene of the place. If you wanna have a quick bite this would be ideal if you are around silk board towards hsr.
Good place with Nostalgic restaurant setup.. Lovely food, good service. Non veg lovers & north indians can enjoy this place. Must try and recommended

Ordered food(biryani) through Swiggy, have to say that it's not much satisfactory overall, quantity seemed bit less and the quality of Rice definitely needs an improvement, it's not smooth enough appealing to consume neither fragrant.But the boiled eggs were very good and masala mixture texture on those added nice taste to biryani as well.

Very bad experience...Food taste is too bad..n not fresh food..it's seems leftover food thy packed..n not a North Indian cuisine kind of taste..we order biriyani which is very less tasty and not cooked properly..

I am not a great lover for spicy foods much.In my area almost all restaurants flood their curries with full of strong spices and so much that my half stomach only fills water....until then i discovered this fine place.The food here really tastes good and is not too spicy. Well this Swad e punjab,s 2nd outlet i had visited the electronic city one as well. Awsome place to go with family and friends. Ambience was very nice and the staff was polite and obviously food was delicious. I am addicted to this for every weekend. A must visit place.

Good service .. we have ordered chicken Afghani and paneer tikka . Both were good . Ambiance is ok . As it's a panjabi restaurant we have ordered lassi ..the lassi was not good. Ordered kadha paneer...tandoori chicken...n dal fry...excellenyt food n preparation n taste
..chicken was soft n succulent...kadha panner just as you get in Haryana...overall pricey but worth it..

The only advantage this restaurant have is that they donot have any big competitor nearby to them for North Indian Cuisine. Ordered Dum ka Chicken through Food Panda and it was a pickup from us as the restaurant is very nearby to our place.They have good seating arrangement and is covered in large area. But food was pathetic. The gravy was raw and i could feel the raw Garlic pieces in every bite. The Masala was not at all cooked properly and gravy portion was very less sufficient only for a person and if you are having rice with that then forget it even for a person . Now coming to Chicken. There was only 1 big piece, 1 medium size piece and 3 very small boneless pieces.The biggest piece was hard and very chewy. None of the piece had any flavour. Looks like they just dip the chicken as per order and  don't cook it at all.
Overall a bad experience from this place. May be i will try again to judge them for other dishes too.

Ordered food from this eatery through Swiggy. The whole idea was to try from a place which was new to us and we were disappointed big time. The quality and the quantity can't be justified. The biryani was on spicer side. The description of the food no where  matched what we received. The quality of the rice used is almost equivalent to a road side dhaba, a close up of the biryani is also attached here from which the statement can be verified. The only goods were the 1) Raita which was pretty good and 2) the delivery which was taken care by Swiggy.  So all in all if one wants to have a good raita for two, he/she should pay Rs 374 bucks. Punjab would really be embarrassed to have this kind of Swad :(
We went more than 70 people at a time. Food was really awesome with many varieties and taste. Service was superb. They were so many varieties of Veg and Non veg foods. Overall an awesome taste.

Please arrange A/c in hall apart from the room, it will give more value to you and the restaurant as now days it SOOOOO hot in Bangalore (just a suggestion)

Food: 3/5

Ordered main course veg pulav it tasted good but the quantity is comparatively less to the price to the price we are paying. Superb and fast service. Big saviour is no service tax or anything. The one place for a theatre lover to dine in an atmosphere full of art and creativity. The akki rotti is at its best here. It is served with onion chutney which is perfectly prepared. Sabudana vada would be available in the evenings. Paratha are hot and tasty. 
If you are a theatre lover or a bibliophile this is one place you must visit.

All time favorite

This is one of those cafe's where you can go to catch up on your work, meet up fiends or go with family for a casual snack/meal. Small menu but pretty inclusive of various taste buds. Their Akki Roti and Sabudana vadas are my all time favorites. Cozy atmosphere with natural light and air and comfortable seating.

A peek into other options: Sandwiches, Pasta, Appam with stew/curry, Biryani, Parathas, Rotis n gravies, Vada pav, Samosa and many more..

Their Onam Sadya is to die for..
Great Ambience, nice quiet place for chit chat and work. The herb butter toast and pasta are to die for! Enjoy dinner her after watching a play at Rangashankara for a perfect evening.

-A typical rustic setting inside Rangashankara.
-A good spot to catch up on your favorite book or hang out with your friends.
-The food is good and relatively inexpensive.
-Sabudana Vada and Akki Rotti with Pudina Chutney is highly recommended.

Overall Rating 3.5/5

Love the ambience.. a great place to just relax after a play.. inside the rangasankara building.. don't miss the sabudana wada, vada pao.. akkibroti.. rest all stuff is good to ok. Worth trying out once if u r in the locality.

Visit regularly over the weekends over the last 3-4 years Rustic ambience, awesome place to catch up with pals, and hangout. Food is really good - personally a big fan of the kheema pav, akki roti, bhel, pasta, vada pav and kokam juice. The staff are very helpful and accommodate requests for customisations.

The place is awesome.
Akki roti and Spanish omlette are must try.

The wada pav is delicious and one of the best one in Bangalore.

Food here followed by a play adds couple of stars more.

This place is suitable for some quiet time you wana spend n have some food along. Since this place has reviews on Sabudhana Vada written all over it, tried that and it was Okay ! Not a must try place but can try once for a quick food.

Best best best sabudana vada I have ever had in Bangalore!!
This place is really nice and almost everything here which I have tasted so far is really tasty.
Have had Appam and vegetable stew. The stew is really authentic and tasty. Mushroom pasta Alfredo was also delicious. Have had pudina pyaar Parantha which was yummy and left me wanting more.
Once had Chicken masala gravy and phulkas, the gravy was very tasty with all indian masalas and chicken succulent and phulkas was like home made !!
Had buttermilk which was also tasty.
Love this place!!
Ask for the off the menu pasta . it is awesome. Perfect light lunch. And their ice tea is worth worshiping. It is sad they don't sell it by the liter.

Love: The Akki Rotti. I like em sometimes... But it's been awesome here , evertime

Like: Sabudhana vada. Im sure, sales testify.

Remember, this is at Ranga Shankara. So come in at 6.30 pm..... Eat .... Wait in line ... Experience theatre.

Calm, cozy and serves good food !! Everything about this place gives a rustic vibe. Limited menu. We tried the pasta, aloo paratha, aloo tikki , badam milk, hot chocolate and jal jeera. Nothing disappointed us and we loved the pasta and the hot chocolate. An ideal place to relax, read a book and munch away.

Anju's Cafe is one place where one can enjoy tasty hot piping snacks and enjoy the lovely classic ambience. It is an Arty feel to it thanks to Rangashankara. The sabudana vada, bhel puri, akki roti and other chats are just sumptuous. It is a nice place to hang out and have lovely conversations and to your luck you may bump into wonderful theatre artists. It is self-service but the snacks and food id prepared very quickly. And it is  light on the pockets as well.

Biggest positive: laid back ambience
Negative: limited veg options for short eats

Located in the ground floor of Ranga Shankara, the drama theatre. The ambience has an open feel to it, the wooden benches and style of tables give it a simple yet classic feel. It is self service. Dishes prepared Reasonably quick. Bustling with people just before the show in the theatre.

The food is decent. They have a variety of type of food items, from Akki rotti's and chats to pastas. Tried only the chats at this place before a show. The Bhel puri was good. Quantity is decent too. The prices are kept very reasonable.

On the whole, it's a good place to grab a snack before the show in Rangashankara or even a leisure snack/working break by yourself.

As usual a nice place and can never go wrong with this one. Been regular for years though simple menu has a lot to offer. One other certainty is the freshness in their food.

Must try!! A simple n nice place in Ranga shankara..

This is hands-down one of the most pocket friendly cafes in this area . The ambience is perfectly maintained for any one to have a nice chat or for the people watching the play to grab a quick bite before getting into the live theatre . The sabudana vadas are crispy , perfect for my liking . Vada pavs, akki roti , etc . Taste delicious. The lemon ice tea is a must try for cold tea lovers .

This is hands-down one of the most pocket friendly cafes in this area . The ambience is perfectly maintained for any one to have a nice chat or for the people watching the play to grab a quick bite before getting into the live theatre . The sabudana vadas are crispy , perfect for my liking . Vada pavs, akki roti , etc . Taste delicious. The lemon ice tea is a must try for cold tea lovers .

I absolutely love this place.. it's located inside Rangashankara..they serve crispy hot akki rotti.. and the best ginger tomato chutney with it.. Sabudana vada and kokum juice are my personal favourite..

Anju's Cafe is one place where one can enjoy tasty hot piping snacks and enjoy the lovely classic ambience. It is an Arty feel to it thanks to Rangashankara. The sabudana vada, bhel puri, akki roti and other chats are just sumptuous. It is a nice place to hang out and have lovely conversations and to your luck you may bump into wonderful theatre artists. It is self-service but the snacks and food id prepared very quickly. And it is  light on the pockets as well.

Biggest positive: laid back ambience
Negative: limited veg options for short eats

Located in the ground floor of Ranga Shankara, the drama theatre. The ambience has an open feel to it, the wooden benches and style of tables give it a simple yet classic feel. It is self service. Dishes prepared Reasonably quick. Bustling with people just before the show in the theatre.

The food is decent. They have a variety of type of food items, from Akki rotti's and chats to pastas. Tried only the chats at this place before a show. The Bhel puri was good. Quantity is decent too. The prices are kept very reasonable.

On the whole, it's a good place to grab a snack before the show in Rangashankara or even a leisure snack/working break by yourself.

Just love the vibe and food at this iconic cafe. Akki rotti, vada pav and sabudana vadas are known favourites here. This time I tried the Chicken Ghassi with appams and it was pretty good..soft, spongy appams and a not too heavy but well spiced curry. The kiddo was happy with her Alfredo pasta. We also tried the chicken popcorn and it was pretty darn addictive.

Not a place for tasty fud, but gud to enjoy chit chat with small group.

Likes- open air ambience, ambient space between tables, fresh things to munch (includes Indian menus...saboothana vada was gud), interior locality - off from main rd, no plastics.

Very relaxing ambiance. I often go to this place for evening snack after work. A hot cup of coffee n vada pav with a good book makes my day. But sometimes I go for the kheema masala pav(minced chicken with bread).
No doubt that the place is quite. They should really do something about the mosquitos there.

It is quite easy to locate since it is inside the Ranga Shankara theatre complex. A chilled out place with a decent variety of quick bites to basic eats.

The wait can some times be annoying but the food is finger licking good. The Akki rotti is crisp, semi circular n uniformly cooked. It is served with yummy chutney.

I tried the sabudhana Vada. It was a bit cold or else tasted great. People ordered pasta n fries n so on. A bustling place.

Will visit again n again.

Excellent food. Ordered kheema pav and tea. Bread was done just warm and the kheema was delicious. Washed it down with milky tea.

Emboldened, ordered mango custard. It came in a standard chai glass. Delicious. It was very fresh.

Awesome place. Will definitely come again.

It's one of my fav places !! This place s juz warm n welcoming, but sumtimea it's jam packed during the play hours(cafe s associated wid a theatre), the food n snacks are usually good, if u visit dis place den u shud surely taste der akki roti,herb toast,cheese omlet yumm yumm!! And of course der veg white sauce pasta !

Like made in the morning and boiled and served throughout the day. Makes it even harmful for health. Other than that this cafe have many items for quick bites for before and interval breaks.

Muffins are pretty good and goes well with the tea so are other snacks, even sandwiches are good. The place is definitely value for money and recommend. Never get tired of going here.
Good food but service is a little slow. Also, people should learn to queue because 10 people at the counter ordering stuff at the same time isn't very efficient.

Been a regular here. But was pleasantly surprised to find appam and veg stew as an new addition. The stew was amazingly fresh and the appams light and fluffy. But never got the logic of the appam+stew combo coming with only 2 small sized appams. Probably only for the real light eaters. Ordered 2 more to complete the meal with a kokum and jal jeera to wash it down. A little warm but the food makes up for it.

This rating is only for the sabu daana vada and aapam with veg stew ..And maybe even for the hot chocolate .. Do try these and am sure you won't regret .. Not heavy on the pocket, this place is for those people who want to laze around and read a book in peace :) ..il keep coming!

Their menu seems like they have a lot to offer but the food really was terrible.
Tried their juices and they weren't fresh. Their sandwiches are less than mediocre and their parathas were okay.
The ambience isn't something that picks up the place either.
Not a place I'd intend on visiting again.

We frequent this place a lot. The food is tasty and served quickly without any fuss. Appams with stew and banana custard is really good. My husband likes the misal pav. Anju's friendly presence and all the beautiful arty people adds to the charm of the place.

Located inside Ranga Shankar theatre, Anju's Cafe is a really nice place to sit and catch up with friends, while having yummy, pocket friendly food that is wholesome and interesting. Try the Akki Roti when you go there and be sure to have the Banana Custard! The coffee is nice and strong, just the way it should be and goes very well with the Sabudana Vada that is sold in the evenings.

Veg biryani was tasty, wish it was served hot.jaljeera too watery for me.The only reason for this rating is because the place looked really unhygienic to me.The plate they served was very dirty so ended up eating in the bowl directly.I personally like laid back cafes with self service , so there is no complaint on the service perspective provided the guy in the counter is there for your help.

This is a cozy cafe located inside Ranga shankara which serves almost everything from snacks, lunch and some dinner options as well. Menu ranges from muffins, vada pav, sabudana vada, biryanis, pasta, sandwiches, akki roti etc. Pretty good spread. I would have given more rating but since couple of my experience were not that great here. 

Tea is good but you should be lucky if you get it hot, because I have tried it multiple times and majority of the time it was cold so you had to ask them to heat it in microwave which becomes cumbersome given self service. 

Muffins are pretty good and goes well with the tea so are other snacks, even sandwiches are good. 

Biryani is a strict no no, last time I tried it turned out to be stale so my recommendation stay away from it. 

This place is ideal for a quick snack in the evening with bunch of friends and always filled with youngsters so gives a good vibe :)

I would have given more rating but since couple of my experience were not that great here. 

Tea is good but you should be lucky if you get it hot, because I have tried it multiple times and majority of the time it was cold so you had to ask them to heat it in microwave which becomes cumbersome given self service. 

Muffins are pretty good and goes well with the tea so are other snacks, even sandwiches are good. 

Biryani is a strict no no, last time I tried it turned out to be stale so my recommendation stay away from it. 

This place is ideal for a quick snack in the evening with bunch of friends and always filled with youngsters so gives a good vibe :)

The place is definitely value for money and recommend. Never get tired of going here.

Nice ambience! Its a snack place basically! Sabudana vada, samosa and vada pav is good! But I didn't like their special Akki roti....it was very oily! Coffee is fine but didn't like the tea! Overall good place to for quick snacks before going for the play!
Warm, relaxed cafe...very artistic crowd... It's a different theatre experience... You see the talent...with energy...speciality is the Akki rotti... Some decent grub...nice...

The Akki Roti is tasty, if a little oily. Their Veg Biryani is surprisingly good. It's a nice space, specially if you're stopping by after a play.
Their drinks are extremely sweet. The Kokum Juice is mostly purple coloured sugar water, and the Lime Juice was difficult to get down because of the amount of sugar as well.

Obviously the ambience is great...have been going to rangashankara since it started. I have eaten here many times but only during break times from a play so it would be something very quick like a coffee or vada. I didn't think of writing a review till now as, though something was always off it wasn't horrible! I signed up to zomato to let everyone know that my husband and I suffered from food poisoning after eating the misal pav and pav bhaji here. I should have trusted my instincts and not eaten when something smelled stale! Maybe they source cheap quality bread or they use the one with moulds. Or maybe they reuse the bhaji and misal till it gets over. Whatever the case is, ITS NOT DONE !
Sorry Anju, you come across as a sweet person but you can't serve stale food to your customers!
If you love the ambience just order a coffee and have a conversation, don't have the food!

Being a theatre buff, discovering Anju's cafe was inevitable. From being someone who rushes in at the last minute to catch the show, to coming early to drink a cuppa from Anju's - this transition was mostly thanks to the hot chai and vada pav served here.

I'd sing praises about the snacks here, they taste good and have a very homey vibe to them. However the ambiance here is just something else. Not swanky and posh but quiet, calming and unique - with that authentic old school Bangalore touch to it.

Opt for pastas over sandwiches and be prepared for a wait. If your visit coincides with a play coming up, there might be space crunch!

Stand-alone this place might have not received the accolades it does now, but nested amid the culture hub that it is, it's definitely a place you need to visit if you're catching a play!
The best coffee ever!! I would say best everything! A very homely ambience! Can spend time with friends and can also have informal meetings. Must try : Alfredo pasta and herb toast??

This is my most favorite cafe in south bangalore coz it has that real bangalore feel- simple and unpretentious. Diverse menu and fresh food pleases anyone's soul. Matched with good ambience and service.
This place looks very pretty in the evening with the lit lanterns and the wooden fence. Been visiting here since school days and never bored of it.

Cafe is closed on Mondays as the theater.

What to order- Their signature Akki roti and sabudana vada is my all time favorite. Very few places can make decent filter coffee and this cafe is one of them. Banana custard pudding is a must try and so are the egg burji fry with toast and carrot halwa.

It's unique coz of the calm and less noisy environment, total different experience than the loud noisy cafes in rest of bangalore.

So a huge thumbs up ? for this place anytime!!

As someone said, this is Bangalore's answer to Bombay's Prithvi theatre cafe (I do miss the Irish coffee though!)
Whether you want a really quick bite (sabudana vada is the most popular, though I think a bit more masla/ salt in the mix wd be great) or a quick meal before the evening play (most evening plays end really late for dinner), this is a nice friendly place - stereotypically looking arty...
I do love the keema pao and the parathas - the kids love the chicken sandwich and my husband the omelette.
The chai comes highly recommended, I didnt much like the kokum juice.
I think what makes this place superior is the location/ convenience, and the quickness of service.
I would think nice to hang out even if you aren't going to a play - you cd spot some theatre celbs too sometimes (and ofcourse catch the "free" performances that are sometimes done at the lobby

After hearing a lot about this cafe..I finally decided to try it out.

Well about the place , they have showed justice to their ambience by keeping it simple and elegant. It is a self service type system here. From the recommendations mentioned here..I ordered the famous akki roti and keema masala pav. Both of those dishes tasted amazing... the akki roti is must try here. Along with it we had sausage cheese and tuna mayo sandwich, they were good too.
Everyone must try out this place .Good food. Good price.

I totally love the Sabudana vadas here, and they're like this customary thing everytime we go watch a play at rangashankara. They are crispy and chewy and taste so nutty. The vadapaavs are another good speciality.
Yet to get over these and try other things :)

The Akki rotti is "Made at Home", the sabudana vada is ever fresh and hot. Ambience and crowd is just perfect to make this an all time favourite. The Herb Toast is a must try! Very well flavoured and just the right heat when served.  Anju's chaats are finger licking good, overall,  try anything on the menu, and you might just find something that you'll relish!

I do love the keema pao and the parathas - the kids love the chicken sandwich and my husband the omelette.
The chai comes highly recommended, I didnt much like the kokum juice.
I think what makes this place superior is the location/ convenience, and the quickness of service.
I would think nice to hang out even if you aren't going to a play - you cd spot some theatre celbs too sometimes (and ofcourse catch the "free" performances that are sometimes done at the lobby

After hearing a lot about this cafe..I finally decided to try it out.

Well about the place , they have showed justice to their ambience by keeping it simple and elegant. It is a self service type system here. From the recommendations mentioned here..I ordered the famous akki roti and keema masala pav. Both of those dishes tasted amazing... the akki roti is must try here. Along with it we had sausage cheese and tuna mayo sandwich, they were good too.
Everyone must try out this place .Good food. Good price.

I totally love the Sabudana vadas here, and they're like this customary thing everytime we go watch a play at rangashankara. They are crispy and chewy and taste so nutty. The vadapaavs are another good speciality.
Yet to get over these and try other things :)

The Akki rotti is "Made at Home", the sabudana vada is ever fresh and hot. Ambience and crowd is just perfect to make this an all time favourite. The Herb Toast is a must try! Very well flavoured and just the right heat when served.  Anju's chaats are finger licking good, overall,  try anything on the menu, and you might just find something that you'll relish!

One of the best of bengaluru!! Soul food n comfort food! The owner is warm , friendly n caring. Awesome atmosphere! Peaceful, healing and you can sit here for hours together. Except the mosquito s can become a lil too friendly????????????

Tulisi tea and Sabudana vada....Tea and Vada pav... Akki Roti. .... 
Splendid food when you are waiting for the play to start.. Ambiance apt for a theatre but people managing this cafe gets confused when a crowd comes in...

So this is what Bangalore's Prithvi theatre looks like! Awesome. Will go for a play one day until then, its Anju's cafe.

Its a pretty little place (with mosquitoes too, don't take the corner table) with what looks like in house DIY lighting. Very pleasant looking though.

We found us amidst a buzz of people and got ourselves a seat.

Order kheema pao and hot lemon tea. Love that combination here. But everyone seemed to be ordering the akki roti with chutney. This I found, a little too oily for my palette. I loved the kheema pao much much more though.

Lemon ice tea -nope. Self service.
Come here when you feel all artsy.

An honest cafe with honest food. Almost anything I've had at Anju's Cafe tastes good, especially Sabudana Vada, Vada Pav with Chai. I used to mostly only go there before a play at Rangashankara. The last few times I had the chance to meet friends in the area and we ended up ordering Akki Roti, Kheema pav and Appam with Chicken curry. I hope this simple place stays the same forever as it stands for everything that Bangalore used to be.

Why this place : This place is peaceful and food is delicious. Its at Rangashankara theatre.

Ambiance : Its a huge place sort of open place, with typical old style wooden tables and chairs and benches. But this place is peaceful.

Food: "Akkiroti" its must try of this place, crispy hot akkiroti with yummy chutneys. Its one of the place in bangalore which serves best masala akkiroti. Sabudana vada is the fast moving item here, i like sabudana vada preparation of this place.
All drinks in the menu is good. Love the bannana custard what they prepare. Had pulav once even that was pretty decent.

Place to visit with: family, alone, friends.

Must try : masala akkiroti (It gets over very fast)This is self service place.I just love to visit this place.

Food portions: 7/10
Food quality: 6/10
Food  taste: 7/10
VFM : 8/10

It's different. Go for the atmosphere. Intellectually elevating conversations. Mosquito coils. Crazy costumes and chatters around. And an earthy mix of heartland dishes. I had the Akki roti. Am not sure it's there everyday as they have a different menu everyday. But it was a dish to relish. And then the gajar ka halwa. There is something very Bangalore about this place. Go on a random weekday(except Monday) in the evening around 6. Just before the play begins. You'll realise there is so much more to life. The food is great. But the charm is the ambience. And the people that fill it up.

We have had nice experience at Anu's cafe in the past. One gets the most awesome vada pav and sabudana vadas here. However my visit yesterday made me realize that probably those are the only things worth mentioning. I made the mistake of ordering pasta and had a unique fusion pasta where Indian style tomato gravy (sans the garam masala) was probably substituted for pasta sauce, with no seasonings whatsoever. I know that it is not a fine dining place but it was too bad for the price they charge, which is obviously more than any ordinary Indian cafe. I strongly thing they should stick to what they know best.

Anjus cafe @ Rangashankara is my favourite hangout joint. The ambiance is magical, the crowd is brilliant and the FOOD!!! just love It.

The cafe is friendly and makes its guests feel at home. Best place to catch up with friends for a long chat with some tasty food.

YOU MUST NOT MISS
THE AKKI ROTTI ...its yumm. Very traditional and exotic in its taste.

SABUDANA VADA ... light.. crispy and tasty

HERB TOAST. ..the best in town. The herbs and butter taste like heaven. And you can go for plate after plate with tea.

Many more such interesting dishes on the Menu. All taste like they sound and look i, e fantastic. The best thing about Anjus Cafe is that all this great stuff not only tastes good but is light on your wallet too.

Sit here in the dim lights... with the breeze occasionally caressing you, whilst you pour out your heart to a friend along with some food and tea.

:: ANJU'S CAFE @ RANGA SHANKARA ::

If you stay in JP Nagar, its quite possible that you heard about famous 'Rangashankara'. I knew about it for long, but never knew about small cafe inside. I heard about the cafe recently from a friend and visited the cafe twice for light dinner.

I tried these items - Akki Roti, Sabudana Wada, Appam, Arabiatta Pasta, Veg Club Sandwich, Alu Paratha, Kadai Chicken, Spanish Omlet, Masala Omlet, Gajar Ka Halwa, Brownie with Icecream, few varieties of tea, Cold Coffee etc

Almost everything was nice and tasty. Reasonable Prices. Its a casual cafe. Dont expect fine-dining place/food.

Recommended Items: Sabudana Wada, Akki Roti, Pasta

My Feedback: Cool place to have a nice cup of tea/snacks in evening.

Almost every weekend I am here to relax, have a cup of tea with garam garam sabudana wadas.. chit chat with anju, her husband.. or the staff... I have met lots of new people here..

I have tried lot of items from the menu.. sabudana wada to vada pau to pastas to parathas to biryanis to akki roti.. spl Akki roti (pic attached) is my fav item in the menu now.. :)

If you want to be just yourself.. a cool calm place to do your work, read, etc.. with a nice cup of tea.. this is the place.. and at the same time a good place to hangout with friends.. meet new people.. chit chat..this is the place..

good food,good place, and an excellent host :)

I like dingy and hidden places, however, this one was jam packed and people would have to sit way too close to each other in the smoking area.

One nearly unknown place serving great food on Church Street that looks nothing like the photos on Zomato nor does it look like what a 'steakhouse' should look like. Nevertheless, they have a strong command over North East and Oriental cuisine. Food is good, service is fast. What's not to like?

If you like North Eastern cuisine then this is the place for you! The food is very good. We ordered chicken chilli and pork chilli and both were just perfect in taste and perfect sauce.
For the main course we ordered Thai curry and oyster sauce chicken.
The Thai curry is OK kind of. The consistency was very runny and the chicken oyster sauce was not so great.
The service is bad though.
Don't forget to order their in house brewed rice beer which is one of kind of taste.
Really nice place. Good food and the rice beer is a must try! Steaks are really good and so are the salads. Very courteous stuff and if you love north eastern food, this place is a treat! :)

Good joint for steaks. The mashed potatoes is actually a paste though, was not happy about that. The rice beer grows on you eventually. No issues with the service. Ambience is modest, but a bit too dark.

Pork ribs with teriyaki sauce was okay. Also the meat in chilli pork was undercooked. We also ordered smoked pork with vegeatables, bamboo shoots. The broth for this was too hot (chilli) to eat. The biggest disappointment was perhaps not getting zomato gold benefits. Due to network reasons I wasn't able to unlock visit at the time of placing order. Utterly disappointed.

First taste of rice beer was not that great but after that I had 4 glass.
For starters we ordered chilly pork. Loved it.
For main course, pork chops steak. Steak was bland but meat was rightly cooked. We asked for more spicy.
Second time, it tasted good but meat was hard and rubbery.
Definitely going back but will be cautious with the main course dishes.

This place is right at the heart of Church Street but hidden in front of Blue Frog pub. Being near to my office some of us decided to spend the Friday night there. The place is not very big but has a small outside seating arrangement along with indoor seating. It was packed outside so 6 of us sat. The place is famous for northeastern and Asian cuisine. We ordered Chicken Hakka style and Chilli Pork for starters. For the main course, we ordered the Hunan Jein, Baby Pork Ribs, Chicken steak and some Fresh pork stew with plain rice. We finished our dinner with the chocolate cake and tiramisu. They serve a hefty portion of these heavens. Staffs are very hospitable and would love to visit again.

The teas are very complimentary to the food and so is the rice beer. The curries are divine and are perfectly complimented by the sticky rice. They serve authentic glass noodles.
Food takes quite a while to come as it's all prepared fresh. Service is a little lazy so you're going to have to keep calling your waiter.

A small pocket resteraunt that serves really good food

This place is near to metro station, hence its very convenient to reach to this place after some shopping in MG road and Brigade road. Its in 3rd floor and medium size place. Ambience is cool with dim lights and makes a good environment to have food.

We had some Schezwan noodles, chili chicken and soup noodles which tasted amazing. The noodles were different from other restaurants and had a juicy feeling.

Coming to the price vs taste its absolutely worth it. It has Zomato gold so you can claim that also. Definitely try this restaurant!

A place for fast food and Chinese food. But Not for lunch and dinner.

Quality and quantity were quite ok.
Self-service.

I was there for breakfast. I have tried Dragon Chopsuey. This was my first time for Chopsuey but for me, it was a good experience.

Place happens to be just behind my office and one of the most frequented places by me to get a quick grab of shawarma..The shawarmas are pretty good..has 5 variants of them....one with kerala parotta ..one with a chapatti..one with only chicken...one the regular one in a khuboos and one shawarma plate and fries. Sharimul is the guys and he is pretty quick and well behaved.
Over all never had a bad experience eating here. The place is clean. Does not seem to have anybhygine problems.Good to have quick food on move.

Here on team dinner, probably about 35 of us. The service was so horrible, the time taken to settle down and to serve water to the glass took them 30mins. But by the time the waiter started taking orders from one of the table never reached the third table until another 15mins.
The service was pathetic, they could not serve the first two tables orders and the waiter could not even get the orders from nearly 4 tables. The manchurian items were oily less spicy and average. The waiter was arrogant in saying no to whatever we had asked. They do not have Masala Papad, Any items of Baby Corn and Onion Pakoda. What sort of a South Indian restaurant would not have these?
We were left with no other choice but to leave the restaurant as their service was too slow.
Advise: Do not even think of trying. You'll end up wanting your money, time and patience.
More water than juice.

We have ordered Oegano special fruit salad. It came very late and quality and quantity was not good. It was not worth the money. I have called the restaurant and informed him. It's like very embarrassing to ask them to serve little more quantity. I gave rating for ambiance. Food is also below average.

Was passing by during meal time near Domlur and we were searching for some restaurant near us to finish with our Lunch and we came by Avanti Indian Barbeque and Grill and decided our search ends here. Pathetic would be praise!!
Avoid this place like the plague!
Sleep hungry stay safe!

Decent place and decent food ... That's all we can briefly say about this place. They have limited starters and limited deserts but taste wise you will like all for sure . Food is not so great. but decent. ambiance is great. and food spread is less compared to a standard buffet.

ambiance - 4.5/5
value for money - 3.5/5
may need to improve on food spreads..and quality of food to match with the great ambiance.
Very close by to our office campus so will be a choice of visit if time to travel is a constraint.

What differentiates Al Noor from others is that the chicken is really tender and the spices really penetrate the entire meat. Triple chocolate

Butterscotch

Cookies and cream

Ambience: 4/5

The seekh had a good taste until the after effect of the meat fat covering my mouth was displeasing.
A starrer and must have is the chicken tikka roll which was good.
Another starter worth a try is their lemon chicken which is tangy and saucy.
In the mains the Zabardast chicken is an average Indian spicy curry.
The ambience is pleasant and has large outdoor space as well. The atmosphere and crowd is with families and couples around.

The naan and paneer were their best dishes. The service was prompt, and since the sitting area is outdoors, they had a fancy under the table coal warmer / bug repellant

I visited this restaurant with my friends for a birthday party. The ambience is very good. There are places to dine on the roof top or in the outdoor garden or indoor.
The menu is not too big that is a good thing. But what I felt is that the place is not for non veg lovers. For main course they have only dishes with boneless chicken, and that too are made with almost minced chicken. The variety of breads are huge. They serve some awesome kulchha, roti etc...
The service also I felt should have been better. There were not many customers on the day we visited but still the service was lagging behind.
The price is ok. Not too expensive and not too cheap.
For occasionally having dinner with family and friends it's a good palce and that too for vegetarians. But for foodies, not the best choice.
Food - 3/5
Service - 3/5
Price - 3.5/5

Accessible easily as it is located in a prime location. But that can not be the selling point always.

Manchow soup and till-coriander butter naan were really good. Chiken and paneer gravy dishes could be better. Lassi and buttermilk were a disappointed though.

Yesterday ordered food for dinner from this outlet. The place is actually far from our apartment but as the food quality is good, we usually ordered food from here.

We ordered - 1 tengri Kebab, 2 plain naan, 2 plain kulcha, 1 chicken makhani & 1 mutton afghani.

Tengri kebab was good & the pieces were really soft & juicy. The spiciness was mild & flavour was extreme.

Naan & kulcha was as usual, nothing special. Specially the Kulcha was very well made.

Chicken Makhani was outstanding in one word. The gravy with buttery taste was something, which you really don't want to miss. The chicken pieces were really soft & juicy. Perfect item to have it with naan or kulcha.

It the chicken item was hit then the mutton afghani was super hit. The mutton pieces were well marinated & extremely well cooked. I recommend this to everyone those who are looking for side dishes for any kind of bread.

Overall we had a great dining experiences.

One of the fine dine place near to kundanahalli gate which you can always keep as option with great ambience and awesome taste of food.
.
I have been there 3 times till now and it never disappointed me. Staffs were friendly. Its a nice place for dinner for both vegetarians and non vegiterians...
.

Visited this place for a late lunch. Ordered a couple of starters. The veg seekh kabab was average at it's best. Next we had the gobi chilly which was also average. Moving on to main course we had kulcha and roti with kadai paneer. While the roti itself was good, the gravy was bad absolutely no taste. We added some pickle to improve the taste. Badly wanted to give 2.5 but 3/5 is all I can give

i ordered a chicken biryani from this place today. received it neatly packed and warm.

there are two nice chunky juicy pieces of drumsticks and half egg in the biryani. its not authentic dum biryani but good. liked it.

they could do well to tone down on oil and salt. apt quantity. can give this place a try. if not you wont be missing anything either.

Went for just a casual dinner with friends.
The ambience is simply superb and the weather made it a pleasant experience. Coming to the food - full 5 stars for food . chimney kabab is a must try. Started with the soup and both tomato and manchow soups were really good. Lahori naan is a good option with spicy curry.
Did not like the service though. No tissues on the table and main course took too much time after the starters. Otherwise would have gone with full 5 stars.

Service is very poor when asked for menu they pointed me to take from the table where there was a family sitting( I guess u just have one menu) next i took a sit and the food I ordered came oh not to forget they take 20 mins for a hot told by them only. U don't get water until u ask. I saw the chef running outside the kitchen with my hotdog confused and asking servers is it a takeaway. Cashier busy cracking jokes and talking on phone.

A poor experience in a fancy looking cafe.

We ordered for a Irish coffee and a Fruit forest pastry, the irish coffee was rich in coffee with almonds in it and the fruit forest had loads of fruits, they were good, I felt the latter was a little too sweet though. I also took a fruit custard, veg puff and a watermelon milkshake. Fruit custard was ok, veg puff was really good and watermelon shake was decent, I mean I liked it but it was too sweet.

The second time I had been there I had a mango pastry, mexican fries, wedges and a watermelon ice tea, all were perfect.

The staff were courteous. If you happen to be chilling there they serve it to your tables. They aren't very pricey, they are moderate, they also have a widespread of breads and bakery items on the rack.

So, in the middle of vegetables vendors and small bakeries, there's this cafe.
I loved the interiors. The lighting is nice and subtle. You can 'chill' here as long as you can. There is everything you need from the dessert section here. There are Indian sweets, like jalebi to cakes (pastries) and milkshakes. Sandwiches and other snack items are also in the menu.
We ordered 2 different flavours of pastries, Belgian Chocolate and Ferrero Rocher. Tasted good and fresh.
The service is quick. What you see is what you pay. No extra taxes included in the bill.
Loved this new place ?

This place doubles up as a the Canteen for the Specialist Hospital and also as a restaurant for anyone who wants to walk in.
My wife and I got to try the food here when we went for a health check-up to the hospital, after drawing the fasting blood sample you get to have breakfast here as part of the package.
We found the quality and tatse of the dishes to be surprisingly good. Loved the Pongal, vada, idli and also coffee. Only challenge is if a hospital canteen will ever be my go to place for food!?

Only if you have no other option in the area, go here.

Decent meals are available here.

For breakfast, I had a cup of Coffee and Poori Bhaji. The coffee was exceptionally good. Pooro Bhaji was fresh and hot, but the Bhaji ended up being a potato curry.

For lunch, I had Chicken Fried Rice. The rice was good with some great ingredients and enough pieces of chicken however, the quantity was too much and it ended up being very dry to the throat.

I suggest you'll to reduce the quality and add a little curry as food must not go to waste.

Specialist Restaurant is a part Specialist hospital group and is above the Specialist pharmacy. Primarily it caters to the needs of patients and their visitors but the restaurant is open to all. The place is hygenic and not busy. The Service is quick and staff is courteous. Mostly their menu keeps changing and subject to availability. Quantity is reasonable, we had chapati today which was served with dal and sabji. Dal was thick and sabji's taste was good. Roti was soft and fluffy. Price is really reasonable. Do not expect spicy food here.

Its not a place you would normally visit unless you are at the adjoining hospital. The fresh juices and really good. The food dished out is average and not something you would write home about but good for the hospital environment.
Empire does it again. Authentic Mughlai cuisine, if you are a fan of Non veg delicacies, this is the place to be. Highlight of the place - out of the world Haleem.

So, this was a long time pending and also a review I had to write. First of all I would like to start off with the decor; the place was fantastic, with beautifully lit interiors and aesthetically decorated exteriors. The place gives you such positive vibes. Secondly, this cafe serves some delicious food and mouth-watering food. The cherry on the top being the fact that they host live shows on certain days and calling ahead would always does help. The place is tucked in from the main road hence avoiding all the noisy traffic plying on the main road and is the ideal place for a quiet hangout. If you do ever drop by you should chat up with the guy who runs the place. He has a big heart and a great conversationalist.

Visited this place with my friends on a lazy afternoon for lunch... The place was quite empty :p but food here is really good... We ordered a godfather from the starters which was served with a tangy sauce and basket full of love which is basically potato wedges and two kinds of French fries with 4 different sauses , pesto fettucine was average and the veggie pizza was nice.
Reasonably good food at a joint that seemed like a neighbourhood hangout with youngsters digging in their shakes and sandwiches. Has an open area/garden as well.

Food- very good.
Ordered,
Starters: fury wings in barbeque sauce, sausages wrapped with bacon (must try). (Rating: 4/5)
Mocktails: Melonicious ( Watermelon based), Blue Shoes ( Blue lagoon based), Monica Sangria (Iced tea based). All of them were average in taste. (Rating: 3/5)
Main course: Tenderloin steak. (Could have been softer), Chicken Steak in mushroom sauce.(Rating: 3.5/5)
Ambience- very good. (Rating: 4/5)
Staff- Not courteous at all. They were in a hurry to send us home. (Rating: 1/5)

Ordered chicken biryani(small) from this place via swiggy..

Since i ordered in, I can't talk about ambience or cleanliness of this place, so lets talk about just food.

The Biryani costed Rs/-286. Though it's mentioned as "small".. the quantity suffices for one person.

The Biryani had 2 decent sized chicken pieces but most of it was bone...the Biryani had a nice distinct aroma to it, so was tempted to taste it.

Taste was OK-OK types, this was not a dum cooked Biryani. The raita which was served was good.

Overall , for that price, Biryani was disappointing.

In one word : depressing. I'm known to not usually be a generally happy person to be around, but this sort of restaurant can plunge me into even greater states of despair and dismay. Why do all restaurants that have the name "Paradise" or "Deluxe" turn out to be anything but? The Andhra tradition of making biryani has slowly devolved into some sort of cruel joke. There are still some places that make the delicious and overly spicy version of that sort of biryani, but this is how this biryani tastes - rice dumped in vegetable oil, throw in some chilli powder, and throw in one piece of boiled chicken, wrap and serve. It isn't delicious, it isn't satisfying, and it isn't funny anymore. There is a worse place for Biryani in the area, namely the infamous Sultans Biryani that purposely serves only bones, but this is a close second to them, along with the sickening Ammis Biryani. In one word : depressing. I'm known to not usually be a generally happy person to be around, but this sort of restaurant can plunge me into even greater states of despair and dismay. Why do all restaurants that have the name "Paradise" or "Deluxe" turn out to be anything but? The Andhra tradition of making biryani has slowly devolved into some sort of cruel joke. There are still some places that make the delicious and overly spicy version of that sort of biryani, but this is how this biryani tastes - rice dumped in vegetable oil, throw in some chilli powder, and throw in one piece of boiled chicken, wrap and serve. It isn't delicious, it isn't satisfying, and it isn't funny anymore. There is a worse place for Biryani in the area, namely the infamous Sultans Biryani that purposely serves only bones, but this is a close second to them, along with the sickening Ammis Biryani. If you enjoy food that will make you throw up and pay for it, order from here.

I am new to Bangalore and its food habits. So thought of visiting places which are more popular here, to start with. Now when i talk about Nandini and i look for it on zomato i see they have a lot of branches. This being close to my work place I was there this Tuesday. Tried their Ghee Bhaat, Lemon Chicken and Andhra Style Chilli Chicken and they were all good in taste and quantity. Lemon chicken was a drawback though as there was hardly any taste of lemon in it. Being a foodie from kolkata with its unique taste buds its tough to take the curry patta in everything factor but slowly trying to adjust with it. Over all a good place. Although cleanliness is a major factor here as its not that clean.

The worst place to order from. I stay 2 houses away and it took more than an hour for food to be delivered. I walked till the restaurant the first time and the manager lied to me saying that the delivery boy had left. Called the delivery guy after ten minutes when I reached home and he said that he was still in the restaurant. This is 50 minutes after placing my order. Still it took the delivery guy half an hour to come between which I walked till the restaurant the second time. The restaurant's excuse was that it was raining. I walked the same way that the delivery guy came from twice which is 50 meters away and it was not raining. Really poor service and even when the food came I asked for some compensation to which I was declined saying that it was raining. Really poor and slow service. Should not go to this place or eat at this place ever.

I love this place for just their Andhra meal. There veg and dal alone gives such a pleasure,  they probably have a hidden gem in their kitchen. Other a-la-carte items are satisfactory. I haven't found such taste in other Nandhini's.

Once a good place for some good food. But now its purely money and no quality service or food. Menus on the card are really overpriced. Unfortunately this is the only Andra Style hotel in Frazer town so many really don't have a choice.

Their portions are good and pricing is appropriate. 
Must Try - Andra meals just for the rice and pappu!

Nandhini has maintained a formidable repertoire when it comes to andhra style meals and never disappoints when it comes to quality and quantity. The demand is very high and sometimes it is hard to find a place for a meal on any given afternoon. Little disappointed with the home delivery as we have always had to wait for more than one hour for our food to be delivered which has resulted in the curd getting hot and the papad soggy. Apart from this small problem, a great place to visit for andhra style delicacies.

Located beside Frazer Town Bata, this Place serves Andra cuisine. The interiors are average. Service is quick.It's famous for its Andra Meals served on a banana leaf. The quality of rice is good and the dal(pappu) is delicious. Sambar, Vegetable and Rasam are very average. Being an Andra place, it's weird  that they say Gongura chutney is not available. Have also tried their Guntur chicken and Biryani. They were spicy and good.
Their portions are good and pricing is appropriate. 
Must Try - Andra meals just for the rice and pappu!

Unprofessional treatment. Food was ok.
Went for dinner today with family. Didn't feel comfortable there. Management should train the staff well.

Been to this place with a big gang of friends. Cleanliness is a bit of concern. Food is good, nothing great. But the chicken ghee roast was a great first try for me! Orders were served quickly. Easy on pocket, and staff coordinated well with my big gang and their varied orders.

Once upon a time this Hyderabadi dum biryani here use to taste awesome and was the real deal..now the quality has gone down
The carrier meals could serve rice for upto 2-3 people along with dal,now even that has reduced
I personally still like their Andhra veg meals served on a plantain and the mushroom chilli fry. Wouldnt recommend the chilli chicken here though

The only thing I have eaten here is the veg thali. This is an option best exercised on a day when breakfast was early and sparse, you have worked out to your heart's content and are ready for a bid meal for lunch. And you anticipate dinner will be soup and salad. maybe 2 dry rotis and raitha. :)

No, seriously. The thali is huge! You realise how huge when you pack a thali as takeaway. You get a veritable pillow of rice. And probably two dozen packets of assorted things to eat it with. There is no way a normal human being can be expected to finish everything in that thali! Having said which, the rice+ghee+podi combination with a side of the pappu/ dry vegetables by itself is a great meal. It is delicious and has all the elements of a nice lunch. Add the sambar, rasam, other stew like elements, the 4-5 vegetables, curd, buttermilk, and that sweet right at the end.. and you have a feast for kings.

I have given it a 2 ONLY for the authentic andhra meals. The place is very shabby and overcrowded all the time.

The management of this place has to realise that it has passed its prime and a renovation is in order. Most of the time I stop by to take away the food but even for that you should be prepared to wait atleast 45 mins.!!

But then it's very entertaining as there is always a fight going on between a customer n the people who work there.

This is an authentic Andhra restaurant which serves good food at affordable prices. You get your money's worth. The non-veg biriyanis are a must try. The service is very good. Be sure to be there early to avoid the lunch hour rush. I would say go for it.

We always patronize your Nandhini Deluxe restaurant, Coles road, as we enjoyed your dishes particularly the Meal & Biryani also our favorite dishes like Puppu kurra , Gonkura patchadi,etc...
We regularly pack thali meal atleast twice a week., but today after buying two meals at your Coles road outlet and on returning home we were shocked to notice there was No Puppu kurra and Gonkura (that was specially asked to pack).
We felt cheated on noticing these missing dishes and hence called your hotel telephone nos after several calls (30min)., no one answered the calls too and were very rude and were disconnecting my calls.
We live so far away near KR puram and spending so much money on petrol by car we decided never to visit your restaurant again ...
Please do not cheat customers on food after charging so much money - you and your family will not prosper !!
Ramkumar Gopisetty

Food tastes decent. Reasonably priced. Door delivery is quick and reliable. The place could have had better ambience.

The only thing I have eaten here is the veg thali. This is an option best exercised on a day when breakfast was early and sparse, you have worked out to your heart's content and are ready for a bid meal for lunch. And you anticipate dinner will be soup and salad. maybe 2 dry rotis and raitha. :)

No, seriously. The thali is huge! You realise how huge when you pack a thali as takeaway. You get a veritable pillow of rice. And probably two dozen packets of assorted things to eat it with. There is no way a normal human being can be expected to finish everything in that thali! Having said which, the rice+ghee+podi combination with a side of the pappu/ dry vegetables by itself is a great meal. It is delicious and has all the elements of a nice lunch. Add the sambar, rasam, other stew like elements, the 4-5 vegetables, curd, buttermilk, and that sweet right at the end.. and you have a feast for kings.

I have given it a 2 ONLY for the authentic andhra meals. The place is very shabby and overcrowded all the time.

The management of this place has to realise that it has passed its prime and a renovation is in order. Most of the time I stop by to take away the food but even for that you should be prepared to wait atleast 45 mins.!!

But then it's very entertaining as there is always a fight going on between a customer n the people who work there.

This is an authentic Andhra restaurant which serves good food at affordable prices. You get your money's worth. The non-veg biriyanis are a must try. The service is very good. Be sure to be there early to avoid the lunch hour rush. I would say go for it.

We always patronize your Nandhini Deluxe restaurant, Coles road, as we enjoyed your dishes particularly the Meal & Biryani also our favorite dishes like Puppu kurra , Gonkura patchadi,etc...
We regularly pack thali meal atleast twice a week., but today after buying two meals at your Coles road outlet and on returning home we were shocked to notice there was No Puppu kurra and Gonkura (that was specially asked to pack).
We felt cheated on noticing these missing dishes and hence called your hotel telephone nos after several calls (30min)., no one answered the calls too and were very rude and were disconnecting my calls.
We live so far away near KR puram and spending so much money on petrol by car we decided never to visit your restaurant again ...
Please do not cheat customers on food after charging so much money - you and your family will not prosper !!
Ramkumar Gopisetty

It is a surprise this hotel is so crowded, yet doesn't get too many reviews.
The mini meals is in no sense 'mini' and you really will have something left over even after filling your tummy. The waiters are extremely cordial and the biryani here is truly authentic. I suggest you go here at least twice- once to try the mini meals and once for the biryani and other fusion items.
The meals menu is complete with Andhra 'podis', sambhar, kootu and oodles of ghee. If you are feeling lazy and don't wish to step out, order in from their menu. The food arrives hot and is packed very neatly.
A touch of home for a reasonable price? I'm always in!

The Mini-Meals here is just the best for someone who'd like some simple, yet tasty Andhra food...
Love the Lime Soda here..
The Chicken 65 is definitely worth a try!

I referred Zomato before reaching Nandhini Deluxe.. The menu provided was really informative...The ambiance is good the place was also not really crowded the service provided by the staff was nice.. They help us out in selecting the best dish and they also explain in detail about the dishes..The Chicken Biryani was really very tasty, spicy and delicious...yummy....it was really sensational, great flavour.. It was incredibly good and i loved eating it...Chicken was juicy....with raitha...
Ordered the chicken biryani chicken kebab combo... It was not at all worth it.. only the quantity of rice was more.. else it was bad... Please improve we couldn't eat most of it
This is the nearest restaurant from my UB City office. Cheap and good on quantity as well as quality. I often have paratha or biriyani here..
The 'lunch under 99' offer of Zomato is really good. Ordered biryani from this, didn't expect much, surprisingly they delivered a good quantity and it tasted good as well.
An average experience. The place is done up cute. We ordered several parathas none of which tasted great. Service was extremely slow. Not recommended.
Tasty food with neatly packed.and good service,i orderd tender coconut and sandwich it was very tasty and awesome.Also we can call to caferia and tell ur taste they will respond very quickly.
I had tender coconut milk shake and sandwich here yesterday and it was delicious.and I recommend to who are searching for a tasty things please go to caferia it is very good.

A good place. Nice surroundings. Great events. So many books to pick and read and also buy.  Food is decent. Nothing extra ordinary. Their coffee is quite nice so as the breakfast options like maggi or sandwich.  But the place run so high on cultural activities and good, knowledgeable and positive ambiance that these smaller details does not matter much.

Tempura shrimp sushi rolls- 5/5
Cantonese style chicken pan fried noodles- 4/5

Loved the ambience, food and behavior of the staff. The sushi was super delicious. It was served with ginger pickle, wasabi and edible flower(though we missed eating the flower). It satisfied my 3 senses of smell taste and vision. The shrimps were flavorful, the seaweed crisp and the sushi caviar popped beautifully in my mouth.
The Cantonese style chicken pan fried noodles was good too. The quantity was huge... enough for 2 people. It had sufficient chicken and veggies.

The staff were very courteous and helpful.

Would love to come back again soon.

Amazing place. This was there on my list for a very long time and today dining here is totally worth all the wait. We ordered Hunan prawn, chicken dumplings, lamb pepper black sauce and veg fried rice. All the dishes were delicious. And the complimentary Aam panna (crush) shot was just too good!
Ambience great.
Staff - very courteous
On pocket- heavier side (but totally worth it)
A must go!!!

This is my second visit to Asia kitchen. The food and ambience is great here. Of many dishes I've tried here the Prawns and crabmeat rice really stood out in flavour. The prawn sushi roll was great as well coupled with soy sauce.
I'd definitely visit here again with friends or family. The staff here is friendly, my compliments to Mr. Pronay for his courteous service.
Everything from the appetizers to the dessert was great. Brilliant service as well. The waiting can get quite long on weekends so it's best to make a reservation.
A refreshing change. Loved the pan fried noodles and Hunan prawns. Good service and no nonsense ambience. Special thanks to Pronoy for recommending the right dishes. Do visit this one.

... just awsome ..??
one of the best chinese buffet i have been there in bangaluru ..
i loved the starters so much .. in between they gave one sweet taste changer... even crabs and sushi was tasty ..??
food was incredibly and tasty ..
staff was overwhelming polite ..
good ambience ..
overall experience is amazing ..
want to visit this place again ...??

This is not just one of the Chinese restaurant. It's one of the best in Bangalore. I'm surprised how come I didn't got my eyes on this restaurant earlier. I tried prawns for the first time and it was totally worth it. The rice was soft and marvellous.

Ambience 4.5/5
Food 4.4/5
Music 3.8/5
Cleanliness 5/5
Service 4.9/5

Coming here again for food vlogging. Hope I'm allowed
Mind-blowing. That's all I would say about this place. Asian food at this place is world class and loved each and every bite of it. Loved their Momos and pad Thai noodles. Must try.

Had our team lunch outing and we decided to head to this place which is located on the JNC road. The buffet spread was good. The pricing on the drinks are on the higher side. Normally there would be a welcome drink served on almost all buffet places, but this place does not do that. The starters where excellent but the main course was not up to the mark. Service was quick and the music played just did not fit in with their ambiance. would love to visit again tho ?

I have visited this place for dinner with one of my friends. Had chosen the place based on Zomato ratings and I can say that we didn't go wrong.

We had called ahead just to ensure that there is no wait. The place was quite full considering the weekday. The ambience was pleasant and the service was great.

We had ordered a starter, fried rice and a curry to go with it. Food was very tasty and the portion was just right.

I recommend this place for anybody looking for tasty food and want to spend some good time friends and family. Also, they are part of Zomato Gold, which makes it even better.

This place has a great ambience and service. We ordered chilli garlic noodles and it was the best I have had so far in Bangalore.
They served complimentary apple flavored drink that was really refreshing and great after all that spicy food.

This place is a perfect spot for a chilled out Chinese buffet. You may feel that some of the food doesn't do justice to the ratings on zomato. But the ambience and the desserts make up for everything. A must visit if in Bangalore.
Ambience : 5/5
Service : 4.5/5
Food : 4/5
Awesome food, very good staff, good ambience and worth the money you spend here.. highly recommend to everyone. Make your reservation in advance to avoid waiting..

One of my favourite places to go to for Pan-Asian food. The service has always been upto the mark and they?ve always served on time. I?ve been here thrice and never been disappointed. With gold, this place gets even better. The sushi is less in quantity, but good in quality. Their peppered chicken is one of my personal favourites, and their lemon grass chicken fried rice was good in quantity and good in taste as well. In addition to this, they also serve a ?taste enhancer? sorbet which is to be taken as a shot, and often provide complimentary dishes. Recommend this place.
Excellent service from the word go. Loved the food and the spread. The chef takes special care to cater to your needs. Would love to come back.

Polite staff. Good ambience. You get everything here from food to sewing kit ( not kidding ). The service is fast and the food is ammmazinngg. Brownie points for the service. Must try place if you like Chinese

I had a great experience dining here with friend.

Earlier today. I had their Lotus Stem as my opening apetizer and must say the size and taste made me extremely happy. I chose to order their Nigiri and Sushi platter for mains and was extremely delighted not just by its presentation but the favour and authenticity of the dish. Although the Sushi is a tad indianized with Mayo topping, I feel it will be well accepted by Indians and would be popular. My sweet ending included their speciality, the Chocolate Dome which is always my steady order at all restaurants.of this chain wherever available including Mainland China

I love Asia Kitchen in Kolkata and so didn't hesitate for a minute to celebrate my anniversary over there when I went to Bangalore! The ambience is amazing and as usual the staff behavior was very polite and warm.
We tried
1: duck rolls: this was the highlight of the entire meal!! Loved it. So crispy on the outside and the duck meat was succulent. The sauce went perfectly with it! It's a 5/5

4: lamb(I'm so sorry I forgot the name of the dish!): The lamb was the second highlight of the meal! Amaaaazing cooking on the lamb and it was too good. It was my personal favourite. 5/5
5: spring Jade: refreshing and subtle! I've tried it before over here in Kolkata! This one tasted exactly the same! 5/5

Definitely a brilliant experience! Loved everything!

As we sat near the kitchen it had big mouses roaming i side kitchen and it suddenly went right through our table. Suggestion to the management will be to please take care, and do a proper rodent control treatments.
